text.body: śrī || saccidānandaśivābhinavanṛsiṃhabhāratīsvāmicaraṇāravindābhyāṃnamaḥ|| ||śrīvivekacūḍāmaṇiḥsavyākhyaḥ|| (dakṣiṇāmūrtidyyānam) saṃsārasāgaranimagnajanoddidhīrṣuḥ yovātaracchivanṛsiṃhagurucchalena | jāḍyāndhakāraharaṇaṃ karuṇāsamudraṃ taṃ dakṣiṇāsyamaniśaṃ hṛdibhāvayāmi || (śāradāprārthanam) jñānasvarūpe vāgdevi bhagvatpādapūjite | cūḍāmaṇiṃvivekādiṃ vyākuruṣva mukhānmama || prasannānāṃ gabhīrāṇāṃ vacasāṃ deśikeśituḥ | bhāvastvatkṛpayā citte bhāsatāṃ mama śārade || (gaṇeśaprārthanam) ratnagarbhagaṇeśāna vighnadhvāntavibhākara | nirvighnaṃ pūrayasvemāṃ vyākhyāṃ kāruṇyaśevadhe || (candramaulīśvaraprārthanam) candramaulīśvara vibho brahmavidyāsamāśrita | svānubhūtiṃ prayacchāśu cinmudrāvilastakara || (prakaraṇārthasaṅgrahaḥ) sarvavedāntasiddhāntagocaramtamagocaram| govinadaṃparamānandaṃsadguruṃpraṇatosmyaham||1|| anvayaḥ ahaṃ sarvavedāntasiddhāntagocaram agocaraṃ paramānandaṃ sadguruṃ taṃ govindaṃ praṇataḥ asmi ||1 jantūnāṃnarajanmadurlabhamataḥpuṃstvaṃtatovipratā tasmādvaidikadharmamārgaparatāvidvatvamasmāt param| ātmānātmavivecanaṃsvanubhavobrahmātmanāsaṃsthitiḥ muktirnośatakoṭijanmasukṛtaiḥpuṇyairvinālabhyate||2|| anvayaḥ jantūnāṃ narajanma ataḥ puṃstvaṃ tataḥ vipratā tasmāt vaidikadharmamārgaparatā durlabhaṃ asmāt param vidvatvaṃ ātmānātmavivecanaṃ svanubhavaḥ brahmātmanā saṃsthitiḥ muktiḥ śatakoṭijanmasukṛtaiḥ puṇyaiḥ vinā no labhyate ||2|| śrṛṅgagirijagadguru śrīcandraśekharabhāratīsvāmibhiḥanugṛhītaṃ saṃskṛtavyākhyānam | bhagvadgītāsu -- aśocyānanvaśocastvaṃ prajñāvādāṃśca bhāṣase| gatāsūnagatāsūṃśca nānuśocanti paṇḍitāḥ|| itiślokavadvivekacūḍāmaṇiprakaraṇapratipādyakṛtsnārthasaṅgrāhako'yaṃ ślokaḥ jantūnāmityādiḥ || āstikasyaiva śāstre'dhikārāt prathamaṃ narajanmaprāśastyakathanamukhena śarīravyatiriktātmastitvaṃ tāvad dhvanayati -- jantūnāṃ narajanma durlabhamiti | uktaṃ ca śārīrakabhāṣye -- 'śāstrīye tu vyavahāre yadyapi buddhipūrvakārīnāviditvā ātmanaḥ paralokasambandhamadhikriyate' iti| jantūnāṃ jananaśīlānāṃ prāṇināṃ narajanma mānuṣyakaṃ durlabhamiti | tatra ekenaiva bahuṣu janmasu prāptavyeṣu kila narajanma durlabhamiti vaktuṃśakyaṃ , śarīrasambandhasyaiva janmaśabdārthatvāt | yadā caikasya anekaśarīrayogaḥ tadā śarīravyatiriktatvamātmānaḥsūcitameva| prasiddhaṃ khalvanekaiḥ kusumaiḥ yujyamānaṃ sūtraṃ tebhyo'tiricyata iti,anekāni vāsāṃsi krameṇa yugapadvā paridadhaccharīraṃ tebhyo bhidyata iti ca| tathāca sukhahetuśarīraprāptaye duḥkhahetuśarīranivṛttaye ca puṇyepravṛttiḥpāpānnivṛttiśca yujyata iti,vidhiniṣedhātmakakarmaśāstre āstikasyaivādhikāraḥ| evaṃ jñānena sakalakarmanirharaṇārthaṃ mokṣaśāstrepi| yadi śarīramevātmā syāt tasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt, "ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ" ityādidarśanasādhanavidhānaṃ kathamupapadyeta | "śubhairāpnoti devatvaṃ niṣiddhairnārakīṃ tanum| ubhābhyāṃ puṇyapāpābhyāṃ mānuṣyaṃ labhate'vaśaḥ"|| iti caikasyaiva śubhāśubhamiśrakarmabhiḥ vijātīyaśarīralābhaṃ darśayati| kathamanyathā lokaprasiddhaṃ sukhaduḥkhādivaicitryamupapadyate|yadikarmanirapekṣaḥīśvara eva kāṃścit prāṇinaḥsukhinaḥkāṃścidanyādṛśāṃśca sṛjet vaiṣamynairdhṛṇye bhajeta | tathāceśvaratvaṃ hīyate| taduktaṃ -- "vaiṣabhyanaidhṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāt tathāhi darśayati", "na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvāt", "upapadyate cāpyupalabhyate ca" itisūtraiḥ īśvarasya karmasāpekṣatvaṃ saṃsārasyānāditvaṃ ca| dharmabhūtaḥ saṃsāra eva anādiścet tadāśrayasya saṃsāriṇo'nāditvaṃkaimutikanyāyasiddham | tatsiddhamātmanaḥ śarīravyatiriktatvaṃ, śarīrātiriktātmāstitvavādyevāstika iti|śāstravyavahāranidānamāstikyamiti jantūnāṃ narajanma durlabham ityanena sūcitam | tataḥ puṃstvaṃ, striyā vede'dhikārābhāvāt upaniṣadekasamadhigamyaātmā naiva jñātuṃ śakyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| tatrāpi traivarṇikānāṃ vedādhikārasatve'pi kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ rājyaparipālanakṛṣyādirūpāṇāṃ cittavikṣepahetubhūtānāṃ bāhyavyāpārāṇāṃ satvādaidamparyeṇa ātmavicāraḥ durghaṭa iti -- mukhajānāmayaṃdharmo vaiṣṇavaṃ liṃgadhāraṇam | bāhujātorujātānāṃ nāyaṃ dharmo vidhīyate || iti smṛtyanusāreṇaidamparyeṇa brahmavicārasādhanasaṃnyāsasyāvakāśād ekasminneva janmani brahmādhigamaḥ tayordurlabha iti dyotanārthaṃ dvijatvaṃ tataḥ ityanuktvā tato vipratetyuktam | brāhmaṇasya tu deho'yaṃ nopabhogāya kalpate | iha kleśāya mahate pretyānantasukhāyaca || iti vasiṣṭhasmṛtyā vedavihitapravṛttinivṛttidharmānuṣṭhānena ekasminneva janmani brahmādhigantaṃ śakyaṃ brāhmaṇeneti bhāvaḥ| ata eva tasmād vaidikadharmamārgaparatetyuktam |na kevalaṃ vipratayā labdhavyaṃ labhyate,apitu tāṃ labdhvā taducitadharmānuṣṭhāneneti bhāvaḥ|"dharmo viśvasya jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā....dharmeṇa pāpamapanudati " iti śrutyā dharmasyaiva sukhasādhanatvaṃ duḥkhahetupāpanivartakatvaṃ,tannivṛtyā duḥkhābhāvahetutvaṃceti,sukhaṃ me bhūyāt duḥkhaṃ me mābhūditi sakalajanakāmanāviṣayasukhaduḥkhābhāvarūpapuruṣārthasādhanatvaṃ tasyaiveti dyotayituṃ dharatīti dharmaḥ dhriyate'neneti vā dharmaḥ iti vyutpattyājagatpratiṣṭhāhetutvaṃ tasya śrutibodhitaṃ sūcayituṃ vaidikakarmamārgaparatetyanuktvā dharmamārgetyuktam | vaidikakarmaṇaḥ dharmatvepi karmaśabdena vivakṣitārthālābhāt |yadi dharmavyatiriktaṃ kiṃcitsukhasādhanaṃ duḥkhanivṛttisādhanaṃ ca syāt tatsādhanasaṃpādanena sarvo lokaḥ sarvadā'pi sukhī ,nivṛttaduḥkhaśca syādeva | dharmasya tu atīndriyatvena śāstraikasamadhigamyatvāt janānāṃ tajjñānasya śāstramantarā'saṃbhavātsādhanālābhāt phalālābha iti pratipādayituṃ śakyate | taduktaṃ vaidiketi | dharmasya lakṣaṇaṃ, "codanālakṣaṇortho dharmaḥ " iti jaiminimaharṣibhiḥ sūtritaṃ yat vedapramāṇakatvaṃ tadvaidiketi viśeṣaṇena avagamitam | nahi vedaṃ vinā pramāṇāntaraṃ dharmaviṣaye padamādhātum īṣṭe, tasyātīndriyatvena pratyakṣasya tatrāprasarāt | ata evanānumānaṃtatraprasarati,pratyakṣamūlakatvādanumānapravṛtteḥ || ata eva vedavyatiriktaśabdo'pi na taṃ bodhayituṃ śakyatvāt | smṛtīnāmapi pauruṣeyatvena puruṣāṇāṃ bhramapramādādisambhavena kartṛdoṣanibandhanāprāmāṇyaśaṅkāyāmapauruṣeyatayā doṣagandhānāgandhitaśrutimūlakatayaiva prāmāṇyasya vaktavyatayā vedavyatiriktasya śabdasya dharme svato'pramāṇatvāt | kiñca smṛtikartāro vā atīndriyaṃ dharmaṃ kathaṃ vyajānan ? yogajasāmarthyeneti cet, tatsāmarthyaṃ kathaṃ taiḥ sampāditam ? dharmānuṣṭhāneneti cet, sa dharmaḥ kathaṃ jñātaḥ ? ata eva -- yo brahmāṇaṃ vidadhāti pūrvaṃ yo vai vedāṃśca prahiṇoti tasmai| iti prathamaṃ sṛjyamānasya hiraṇyagarbhasyāpiīśvarānugṛhītavedamūlakameva dharmajñānamiti bodhayati śrutiḥ | kiṃvaktavyamitareṣām?ataḥ suṣṭhūktaṃvaidiketi | abbhakṣā vāyubakṣā itivadvedaikameyatvaṃ dharmasya bodhayati | atra dharmaśabdena pravṛtidharmaḥ nivṛttidharmaśca kathyete| uktaṃ hi gītābhāṣye -- "dvividho hi vedokto dharmaḥ pravṛttilakṣaṇo nivṛttilakṣaṇaśca " iti| dharma eva paramaṃ sādhanaṃ nityasukhāvāptau nānyadapekṣyamastīti karmamīmāṃsakāḥ| tānkaṭākṣayati mārgeti| tena paramapuruṣārtha rsādhanībhūtabrahmasākṣātkārasādhanavedāntavicārahetutvenasaṃnyāsarūpanivṛttidharmasya tatsādhanavairāgyahetubhūtacittaśuddhihetutvena niṣkāmakarmānuṣṭhānarūpapravṛttidharmasya cāpekṣitatvaṃ, na tu sākṣānniratiśayasukhasādhanatvaṃ tadubhayasyeti sūcitam| taduktaṃ bhagavatā bādarāyaṇena -- dvāvimāvatha panthānau yatra vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | pravṛttilakṣaṇ dharmaḥ nivṛttiśca prakīrtitaḥ|| iti| tathāca brāhmaṇena upanayanānantaram vedo nityamadhīyatāṃ taduditaṃ karma svanuṣṭhīyatāṃ teneśasya vidhīyatāmapacitiḥkāmye matistyajyatām| pāpaughaḥ paridhūyatāṃ bhavasukhe dṣ'nusaṃdhīyatām || ātmecchā vyavasīyatāṃ nijagṛhāttūrṇaṃ vinirgamyatām|| saṅgaḥ satsu vidhīyatāṃ bhagavato bhaktirdṛḍhā''dhīyatāṃ śāntyādiḥ paricīyatāṃ dṛḍhataraṃ karmāśu santyajyatām || iti sopānapañcakopadiṣṭarītyā īśvarārpaṇabudhyā karma kurvāṇena cittaṃ śdhayitvā viṣayebhyo virajya karmabhyassamuparamitavyamityetad bodhitam | taduktaṃ mokṣadharmeṣu -- naitādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇasyāsti vittaṃ yathaikatā samatā satyatāca | śīlaṃ sthitirdaṇḍanidhānamārjavaṃ tatastataścoparatiḥ kriyābhyaḥ|| iti vidvatvamaspātparam | tatra pravṛttidharmaviṣaye evaṃ yojanā -- yadeva vidyayā karoti śraddhayopaniṣadā tadeva vīryavattaraṃ bhavati iti cchāndogyaśrutyā kriyamāṇaṃ karma tadaṅgabhūtamantrārthajñānapurassaraṃ kriyate cedbhūyase phalāyeti bodhitaṃ bhavati | taduktaṃ tatraiva bhāṣye dṛṣṭaṃ hi loke vaṇikchabarayoḥ padmarāgamaṇivikraye vaṇijo vijñānādhikyātphalādhikyamiti | nivṛttidharmaviṣaye "saṃnyasya śravaṇaṃ kuryāt" iti vidhānātsaṃnyāsottarakālikavedāntavākyaśravaṇajanyaparokṣajñānavatvaṃ vidvatvam |asmātparamātmānātmavivecanaṃ |idaṃ grantha eva uttaratra spaṣṭayiṣyate | tena mananaṃ yuktibhiḥ śrutārthadṛḍhīkaraṇārthamanucintanarūpaṃ saṃśayabhāvanānirāsakamuktaṃ bhavati | tataḥ svanubhavaḥ,nididhyāsanapūrvakabrahmasākṣātkāraḥkathito bhavati | ata eva svanubhava ityuktam, viparītabhāvanānivartakanididhyāsānabhāve śravaṇamananābhyāṃ jāyamānānubhavaḥ sauṣṭhavaṃ nāśnuta iti | etena śubhecchā vicāraṇā tanumānasā sattvāpattiścti jñānabhūmikācatuṣṭayaṃ kathitamāsīt | asaṃsaktiḥ padārthābhāvanā turyagāca "brahmātmanā saṃsthitiḥ muktiḥ " ityatrasaṃsthitiśabdena vāsanākṣayamanonāśasahakṛtasvanubhavabodhakena vyañjitāḥ | tena sālokyasāmīpyasārūpyasāyujyānāṃ mukhyamuktitvābhāvaśca sūcito bhavati | saguṇaviṣayakatayā teṣāṃ caturṇāmapi mithyātvāt , paricchedatrayaśūnyatvarūpabrahmatvasya saguṇe'sambhavāt | brahmātmanā saṃsthitiḥ kalpitasakalavidhopādhisambandhavidhuranityaśuddhabuddhamuktapratyagabhinnaparipūrṇasvarūpeṇāvasthānaṃ kaivalyameva muktiḥ, śatakoṭijanmasu kṛtaiḥ puṇyairvinā no labhyate ityanvayaḥ||2|| durlabhaṃ trayamevaitad devānugrahahetukam | manuṣyatvaṃ mumukṣutvaṃ mahāpuruṣasaṃśrayaḥ ||3|| anvayaḥ manuṣyatvaṃ mumukṣutvaṃ mahāpuruṣasaṃśrayaḥ (iti) etat daivānugrahahetukam trayam durlabhameva (asti)||3|| labdhvā kathaṃcit narajanma durlabham tatrāpi puṃstvaṃ śrutipāradarśanam| yassvātmamuktayai na yateta mūḍhadhīḥ sa ātmahā svaṃ vinihantyasadgrahāt ||4|| anvayaḥ kathaṃcit durlabhaṃ narajanma labdhvā tatrāpi puṃstvaṃ śrutipāradarśanam yaḥ mūḍhadhīḥ na yateta svātmamuktyai sa svaṃ ātmahā vinihantyasadgrahāt||4|| itaḥ konvasti mūḍhātmā yastu svārthe pramādyati | durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ prāpya tatrāpi pauruṣam ||5|| anvayaḥ itaḥ konvasti mūḍhātmā yaḥ darlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ deha prāpya tatrāpi pauruṣam tu svārthe pramādyati ||5|| paṭhantu śāstrāṇi yajantu devān kurvantu karmāṇi bhajantu devatāḥ | ātmaikyabodhena vinā vimuktiḥ na sidhyati brahmaśatāntare'pi ||6|| anvayaḥ paṭhantu śāstrāṇi yajantu devān kurvantu karmāṇi bhajantu devatāḥ vinā ātmaikyabodhena vimuktiḥ brahmaśatāntarepi na sidhyati ||6|| amṛtatvasya nāśāsti vittenetyeva hi śrutiḥ | bravīti karmaṇo mukteḥahetutvaṃ sphuṭaṃ yataḥ ||7|| anvayaḥ mukteḥ ahetutvaṃ karmaṇo sphuṭaṃ yataḥ śrutiḥ bravīti hi na āśāsti amṛtatvasya vittenetyeva ||7|| bhāṣyam yato bahujanmārjitasukṛtaviśeṣaprāpyaṃ mānuṣapauruṣādikam,yataśca svārthe'pramattena puruṣeṇa bhavitavyam, yataścātyantikaduḥkhanivṛttiniratiśyasukharūpamokṣaḥ ātmaikyabodhena vinā karmakāṇḍādhyayanatadanuṣṭhānādirūpakarmakalāpena sākṣānnāvirbhavati,yataśca śrutireva sākṣādimamarthaṃ,"amṛtatvasya nāśāsti vittena " iti vittasādhyakarmaṇaḥ sākṣānmokṣopayogitvaṃ pratyakṣepsīt ataḥ vimuktyai prayateta vidvāniti -- ato vimuktyai prayateta vidvān saṃnyastabāhyārthasukhaspṛhaḥ san | santaṃ mahāntaṃ samupetya deśikaṃ tenopadiṣṭārthasamāhitātmā ||8|| anvayaḥ ataḥ vidvān prayateta vimuktyai saṃnyastabāhyārthasukhaspṛraḥ san samupetya santaṃ mahāntaṃ deśikaṃ tenopadiṣṭārthasamīhitātmā ||8|| bhāṣyam -- vidvāniti nityā nityavivekī kathitaḥ| ye hisaṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te | ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ|| iti gītāsu budhaśabdenārthasyāsya sūcitatvāt | vaiṣayikasukhasya anityatvaṃ dyotayati bāhyārtheti | arthānāṃ bāhyatvenagantukatayā sārvadikatvābhāvāttatprayojyasukhāvirbhāvasyāpi tādṛśatvamiti | ato vivekinā puruṣadhaureyeṇa tatra spṛhātyaktavyeti prayatnaprakāraṃ prathamamāha saṃnyastabāhyārthasukhaspṛhaḥ sanniti| bāhyāśca te arthāśca bāhyārthāḥ|taiḥ sukhaṃ bāhyārthasukham |tasmin spṛhā, bāhyārthasukhaspṛhā saṃnyastā yena iti aihikāmuṣmikaphalabhogavirāgaḥ kathitaḥ |tena śrutismṛtyuktakarmaṇāṃ niṣkāmānuṣṭhānena nitāntanirmalīkṛtasvāntatvamuktaprāyam | avivekinaḥ viṣayalampaṭasya astitvamapi durlabhamiti sūcayiti sanniti|"ācāryavānpuruṣo veda " "ācāryāddhaiva vidyā viditā sādhisaṣṭhaṃ prāpat" iti śruteḥ atīndriyasya ātmaikyasya guruṃ vinā'dhigantumaśakyatvāt pūrvoktarītyā mahāpuruṣasaṃśrayaḥ kartavya ityāha -- santam ityādinā| astīti san tamityarthaḥ| "asti brahmeti cedveda , santamenaṃ tato viduḥ" "sadeva saumyedamagra āsīt" " yo vai bhūmā tadamṛtam "ato'nyadārtam" "satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma " nāsato vidyate bhāvaḥ nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ | ubhayorapi dṛṣṭo'ntastvanayostatvadarśibhiḥ|| ityādi śrutismṛtibhyaḥ kālatrayābādhyatvarūpāstitvasya brahmaṇyeva satvāt | deśikasya tathātvaṃ " brahmavidbrahmaiva bhavati " iti śrutyā tadabhinnatvāt | tena asadbhyo'nātmabhyaḥ sutarāṃ nivṛttābhimānatvarūpā brahmaniṣṭhā sūcitā bhavati | "tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiḥ śrotriyaṃ brahmaniṣṭham", "ananyaprokte gatiratra nāsti aṇīyānhyatarkyamaṇupramāṇāt "ityādiśrutibhyaḥ tādṛśādeva guroḥ saṃśayabhāvanādivirahitaśuddhātmabodhasya sambhavāt | yuktaṃ hyetat -- loke'pyasmābhiradṛṣṭo mārgaḥ dṛṣṭatanmārgaiḥ kila bodhanīyaḥ|svayameva kathañcillabdho'pi saṃśayaḥ dṛṣṭatattvaiḥ kila nirasanīyo bhavati | tatra śukajanakasaṃvādaḥ pramāṇam |janmāntarakṛtasukṛtaparipākavaśāt svayaṃ jñātajñeyo'pi pitrā*nuśiṣṭo'pi mahānubhavino janakasya vaidehasya vacanātkila brahmaṇi viśrāntamānaso'bhūcchuka iti hi vāsiṣṭhādau smaryate | tathāca svātmābhimukhīkaraṇamiti | ato vimuktyai ityaṣṭamaślokasya iyadbhiḥ ślokaiḥ vivṛtiḥ kṛtā ||15|| medhāvī puruṣo vidvān ūhāpohavicakṣaṇaḥ | adhikāryātmavidyāyāmuktalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ||16|| anvayaḥ uhāpohavicakṣaṇaḥ vidvān medhāvī puruṣaḥ uktalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ātmavidyāyām adhikārī|| 16|| bhāṣyam -- adhikāriṇamāśāste phalasiddhirviśeṣataḥ ityuktamadhikāriṇaṃ prakṛte kathayati medhāvītyādinā -- "dhīrdhāraṇāvatī medhā" iti kośāt śrutārtha dhāraṇakṣamabuddhimānucyate medhā'syāstīti vyutpatyā medhāvīśabdena vidvāniti adhītakāvyakośavyākaraṇaḥ ucyate | ūhāpohavicakṣaṇaḥ etena tarkamīmāṃsāsaṃskṛtabuddhitvaṃ gamyate | padavākyapramāṇajña iti yāvat uktalakṣaṇalakṣita iti aṣṭamaślokādārabhya pañcadaśaślokamadhyapātiślokaiḥ samāsavyāsābhyāṃ sūcitavivekavairāgyaśamādiṣaṭkamumukṣutvarūpasādhanacatuṣṭayasampanna ityarthaḥ | ātmavidyāyāma adhikārī ātmavidyāphalaṃ mokṣamanubhavitumarhatītyarthaḥ ||16|| uktāni lakṣaṇāni sphuṭapratipattaye kroḍīkṛtyāha vivekina iti | yadvā -- uktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jijñāsutvam | "atovicāraḥ kartavyo jijñāsorātmavastunaḥ" ityatra jijñāsureva medhāvitvādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ ātmavidyāphalabhāk | idānīṃ jijñāsāyāṃ kasyādhikāra iti cet, pūrvamaṣṭamaśloke vidvānsaṃyastabāhyārthasukhaspṛhassan, upadiṣṭārthasamāhitātmā iti, daśamaśloke dhīrairiti śabdasūcitasya sādhanacatuṣṭayasampattiviśiṣṭasayetyāha vivekina iti -- vivekino viraktasya śamādiguṇaśālinaḥ | mumukṣoreva hi brahmajijñāsāyogyatā matā ||17 || anvayaḥ brahmajijñāsāyogyatā matā vivekinaḥ viraktasya śamādiguṇaśālinaḥmumukṣoḥeva hi|| 17|| bhāṣyam -- vivekādisvarūpaṃ spaṣṭayiṣyate mūla evopariṣṭāt jñātumicchā jijñāsā, brahmaṇ jijñāsā brahmajijñāsā tatrāvagati paryantaṃ jñānaṃ sanvācyāyā icchāyāḥ karma |akhaṇḍakāravṛttipratiphalitaṃ caitanyaṃ jijñāsāpadalakṣyamāṇavicārasya phalam | sāmānyato brahmajñānasya vicārātpūrvamapi sattvāt etādṛśamiṣṭaṃ saṃpādanīyaṃ cet -- dadyānnāvasaraṃ kiṃcit kāmādīnāṃ manāgapi | āsupterāmṛteḥ kālaṃ nayedvedāntacintayā || ityuktarītyā sārvadikavedāntavicāra āvaśyakaḥ| dehātmajñānavajjñānaṃ dehātmajñānabādhakam | ātmanyeva bhavedyasya sa necchannapi mucyate || ityuktajñānaṃ janayituṃ sa eva samarthaḥ ||17|| etādṛśavicārajananī yā icchā tatra yogyatā vivekādisādhanayutasyaiva nānyasyetyevakārabodhitamarthamanvayena vyatirekeṇa ca spaṣṭayati -- sādhanānīti | sādhanānyatra catvāri kathitāni manīṣībhiḥ | yeṣu satsveva sanniṣṭhā yadabhāve na siddhyati ||18 || anvayaḥ atra manīṣibhiḥ catvāri sādhanāni kathitāni yeṣu satsu eva sanniṣṭhā(sidhyati) yada abhāve na sidhyati|| 18|| bhāṣyam -- loke yasya tāvat kāryatvenābhimatasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogitvaṃ svasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyogikāryatvābhimatakatvaṃ vā tasya tatkāraṇatvaṃ na saṃbhavati | yathā paṭasamānādhikaraṇātyantābhāvapratiyoginī mṛt, mṛtsamānādhikaraṇātyāntābhāva pratiyogipaṭavatī vā sā paṭakāraṇatvaṃ nāśnute | api tu mṛtsatve ghaṭasatvaṃ mṛdabhāve ghaṭābhāva ityanvayavyatirekasahacāragrahavaśāt ghaṭakāraṇatvaṃ bhajate |evaṃ vivekādicatuṣṭayasattva eva sati brahmaṇi nitarāṃ sthitiprayojaka brahmajijñāsāyāḥ sambhavāt tadabhāve cāsambhavāt anvayavyatirekasahacāragrahādhīnā teṣāṃ vivekādīnāṃ sanniṣṭhāparaparyāyaphalaparyantabrahmajijñāsākāraṇatvāvagatiḥ ityuktam | manīṣibhiḥ kathitānīti | tatra manīṣitvaṃ ca śrutitātparyajñānavattvam | śrutyavalambanābhāve etādṛśādhikāriviśeṣaṇānāṃ durjñānatvāt | tādṛśāśca manīṣiṇaḥ bādarāyaṇaprabhṛtayaḥ| te kila "athāto brahmajijñāsā" iti sūtraghaṭakāthaśabdena sādhanacatuṣṭayasampattyānantaryaṃ sūtrayantaḥ brahmajijñāsādhikāriṇamevaṃ vidhaṃ sūtrayāmāsuḥ iti śārīrakamīmāṃsādyādhikaraṇatṛtīyavarṇakabhāṣyāda arthato'vagamyate| etādṛśaviśeṣaṇalambhakaśrutayastu 'yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityam' iti nyāyavatī "tadyathehakarmacito lokaḥkṣīyate evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥkṣīyate", "yo vai bhūmā tadamṛtam, ato'nyadārtam", "na jāyate mriyate vā vipaścit " ityādiśrutiḥ ātmanaḥ nityatvam, anātmanaḥ anityatvaṃ ca bodhayatīti vivekalambhikā | "parīkṣya lokān karmacitān brāhmaṇo nirvedamāyānnāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena", "na vā are patyuḥ kāmāya ityārabhya, "ātmanastu kāmāya sarvapriyaṃ bhavati" ityantā śrutiḥ anātmamātre vairāgyapratipādikā | "śānto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ samāhitaḥśraddhāvitto bhūtvā''tmanyevātmānaṃ paśyet " iti śrutiḥ śamādiṣaṭkaṃ bodhayati| "na sa punarāvartate" iti śrutiḥ mokṣasya nityatvaṃ vadantī tatrecchāmādadhāti| upaniṣadāmarthavādatvaṃ vadatāṃ karmamīmāṃsakānāṃ mate etāsāṃ svārthe tātparyaṃ nāstītyeva jñānasambhavāt "brahmajijñāsitavyaṃ", tatra ca etādṛśaviśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭo'dhikārīti jñānasya durlabhatvāt manīṣibhiḥ kathitānītyuktam | tathā ca pramāṇāntarānadhigatakālatrayābādhyaparamapuruṣārthasvarūpa brahmapratipādakatvādupaniṣadāṃ tāttvikaprāmāṇyasyātraiva sambhavāt tattadvākyasamarpitavivekādiviśiṣṭasyaiva "so'nveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ" ityādivākyavihitajijñāsāyogyateti sarvaṃ caturasram ||18|| tatra vivekino viraktasyetyādinā kathitaṃ vivekādikaṃ kramato nirdiśati ādāvityādinā -- ādau nityānityavastuvivekaḥ parigaṇyate | ihāmutraphalabhogavirāgastadanantaram ||19|| śamādiṣaṭkasaṃpattiḥ mumukṣutvamiti sphuṭam | anvayaḥ ādau nityānityavastuvivekaḥtadanantaraṃ ihāmutraphalabhogavirāgaḥśamādiṣaṭkasampattiḥmumukṣutvaṃ iti sphuṭam parigaṇyate ||19|| bhāṣyam -- vivekādīnāṃ madhye pūrvapūrvasya uttarottarahetutvāt kramaḥ samāśritaḥ| idaṃ nityaṃ idamanityamiti janānaḥ kila anityādvirajyeta | ataḥ nityānityavastuvivekābhāve vairāgyaṃ dussampādam iti vivekasya vairāgyahetutvam | vairāgyavata eva puruṣasya antarbahirindriyanirodharūpaśāntidāntī | tatrāpi niruddhāntaḥkaraṇasyaiva bahirindriyanirodharūpadamaḥ manassambandhābhāve itareṣāmindriyāṇāmakiñcitkaratvāt | tarhi śame sati damasya svatassiddhatvāt kimiti tasya sādhanakoṭipraviṣṭatvamiti cet , "indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṃ manaḥ"| iti gītoktarītyā bāhyendriyanirodhābhāve śamasya dṛḍhatvābhāvāt| jitendriyasyaiva uparamaśabditasaṃnyāsaḥ, tasyaiva śītoṣṇādidvandvasahiṣṇutvarūpā titikṣā, tasyaiva bāhyavikṣepābhāvāt brahmaṇyaidamparyeṇāvasthānalakṣaṇaṃ samādhānam, etāddaśaguṇaviśiṣṭasyaiva brahmaikamasti jaganmithye ityupadiśyamānaguruvedāntavākya viśvāsarūpaśraddhā iti | śamādiṣaṭkamadhye'pi pūrvāparībhāve kāraṇaṃ suvacam| etādṛśaḥ kila puruṣadhaureyaḥ mokṣādanyanna kāmayate, tatra vilambaṃ ca na sahata iti tīvramumukṣāvān bhavitumarhati ityabhiprāyeṇa ādau nityānityetyādyāha| tadanantaraṃ ihāmutraphalabhogavirāga iti ca | tena vivekānantaryasya vairāgye kathanena 'taduditaḥ sa hi yo yadanantaraḥ' iti nyānena vivekakāryatvaṃ vairāgye uktaprāyam | tadanantaramiti uttaratrāpyanuṣajyate vairāgyānantaraṃ śamādisaṃpattiḥ, tadanantaraṃ mumukṣutvamiti ||19|| uktasādhanāni vivṛṇti -- brahmetyādinā | brahma satyaṃ jaganmithyetyevaṃ rūpo viniścayaḥ ||20|| soyaṃ nityānityavastuvivekaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ||201/2|| anvayaḥ brahma satyaṃ jagat mithyā iti evaṃ rūpaḥ viniścayaḥ saḥ ayaṃ nityānityavastuvivekaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ|| 20|| bhāṣyam -- brahma nityaṃ jagadanityamiti niścayasatve'pi dṛḍhaṃ vairāgyaṃ na sambhavati, anityasukhasyāpi prāyaḥ kāmyamānatvāt | jaganmithyetyukte mithyābhūtārthaḥ kenāpi na kāmyate | na hi svāpnikaṃ rājyaṃ kāmayante rājyakāmayitāraḥ| ataḥ vairāgyasya niyatamutpattaye brahma nityaṃ jagadanityamityanuktvā brahma satyaṃ jaganmithyetyāha |viniścaya iti viśeṣṇa niścaya ityarthakena niścaye'prāmāṇyajñānānāskanditatvamuktaṃ bhavati | soyamiti, saḥ vivekina ityatra vivekiviśeṣaṇatvenoktaḥ, ayam ādau nityānityavastuviveka ityuktaḥ ityarthaḥ | asyaiva ऎhikāmuṣmikaphalabhogavirāgahetutvaṃ niyatamiti samudāhṛta ityatra samityupasargeṇa dyotitam ||201/2 || vivekaṃ nirūpya vairāgyaṃ nirūpayati tadvairājyamiti -- tadvairāgyaṃ jugupsā yā darśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ ||21|| dehādibrahmaparyante hyanitye bhogyavastuni ||211/2|| anvayaḥ darśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ dehādibrahmaparyante hi anitye bhogavastuni yā jigupsā(jihāsā) tadvairāgyaṃ || 21|| bhāṣyam -- ऎhikadehādibhogyavastunaḥ darśanena, āmuṣmikadivyadehādi bhogyavastunaḥ śravaṇena, ādipadena dṛṣṭajātīyasya śrutajātīyasya anumānena | anubhūyamānaśarīraprabhṛtibrāhmamānena śatavarṣajīvicaturdaśabhuvanādhipatyāvacchedakahiraṇyagarbhaśarīraparyantaṃ sarvasmin bhogyastuni anitye mithyābhūte yā jugupsā, kadāpīdṛśapadārthasambandho mābhūditi, kākaviṣṭhāyāmivāsahyabuddhiḥ tadvairāgyam | 'śaityaṃ hi yatsā prakṛtirjalasya' itivada vidyeyaprādhānyāt napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ taditi| svadehāśucigandhena na virajyeta yaḥ pumān | vairāgyakāraṇaṃ tasya kimanyadupadiśyatām satataṃ pravāhyamānaiḥ vṛṣabhaiḥaśvaiḥ kharairgajaiḥ mahiṣaiḥ | hā kaṣṭaṃ kṣutkṣāmaiḥ śrāntairno śakyate vaktum || "tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyate evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate", "bhūmnonyadārtam", " kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti", "ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartinorjuna" sūtasaṃhitāyāṃ yajñavaibhavakhaṇḍe saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ, sarvavedāntasiddhāntasārasaṅgrahasthāḥ 'kukṣau svamāturmalamūtramadhye ' ityādinā puṇyakṣaye puṇyakṛto nabhasthaiḥ nipātyamānān śithilīkṛtāṅgan | nakṣatrarūpeṇa divaścayutāṃstān vicārya ko vā viratiṃ na yāti || yatrāsti loke gatitāratamyaṃ ityantāśca ślokāḥ vairāgyaviṣaye'nusaṃdheyāḥ | mānuṣadehādeḥ rogādyupaplutatvaṃ, paśvādīnāmatyantapāratantryaṃ mūkatvādi, devānāṃ rākṣasādipīḍitatvaṃ, śabdādīnāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ bahuvidhānarthapradatvaṃ kuraṅgādidṛṣṭāntaiḥ anusandadhānasya sarvatrānātmasu jugupsā sulabheti bhāvaḥ| etacca 'śabdādibhiḥ pañcabhireve' ityādinā svayamuttaratra spaṣṭayiṣyate | yadyapi "apāma somamamṛtā abhūma" "akṣayyaṃ ha vai cāturmāsyayājinassukṛtaṃ bhavati " iti śrutyavalokanena karmaphalasyāpi nityatvaṃ pratīyate| athāpi 'yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityam' iti nyāyasahakṛta -- tadyatheha karmacita ityādiśrutyanusāreṇa amṛtākṣayyapadayoḥ saṅkucitārthakatvasyāvaśyaṃ vaktavyatvāt na doṣaḥ | uktaṃ hi -- "ābhūtasampalvaṃ sthānamamṛtatvaṃ hi bhāṣyate"| iti ||211/2|| śamasvarūpaṃ bravīti virajyeti -- virajya viṣayavrātāt doṣadṛṣṭyā muhurmuhuḥ ||22|| svalakṣye niyatāvasthā manasaḥ śama ucyate ||221/2|| anvayaḥ doṣadṛṣṭyā viṣayavrātāt muhurmuhuḥ virajya svalakṣye manasaḥ niyatāvasthā (saḥ) śama ucyate|| 22|| bhāṣyam -- ādyantavatvabahuvittavyayāyāsasādhyatvapariṇativirasatvādidoṣān punaḥpunaḥ viṣayeṣu paśyataḥ puruṣasya tatra vairāgyaṃ niyatamiti viṣayadoṣadarśanaṃ vairāgyaheturiti |tasmiṃśca vairāgye sati manassvalakṣye suguṇe nirguṇe vā niyatamavatiṣṭhamānaṃ niścalaṃ nirvikāraṃ bhavatīti manoniyatāvasthārūpaśamasya vairāgyajanyatvamāha virajyeti | tatra lyapā uttarakālikatvasya bodhanāt vairāgyajanyatvaṃ bodhitaṃ bhavati || 221/2 || damaṃ nirūpayati viṣayebhya iti -- viṣayebhyaḥ parāvartya sthāpanaṃ svasvagolake ||23|| ubhayeṣāmindrayāṇāṃ sa damaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||23 1/2 || anvayaḥ viṣayebhyaḥ ubhayeṣāṃ indriyāṇāṃ parāvartya svasvagolake sthāpanaṃ saḥ damaḥ parikīrtitaḥ|| 23|| bhāṣyam -- manasaḥ viṣayavicārasāmarthyasattvātsvata eva virajyetyuktam bāhyendriyāṇāṃ śrotrādīnāṃ jñānakaraṇānāṃ, vāgādīnāṃ karmakaraṇānāṃ ca svatastatra sāmarthyābhāvāt pragrahasthānīyena manasā aśvasthānīyānāṃ bahindriyāṇāṃ śabdādirūpaviṣamamārgebhyaḥ parāvartya parāṅmukhīkṛtya svasvagolake karṇaśaṣkulīvadanādideśeṣu sthāpanaṃ uparatavyāprāratā sampādanaṃ yat sa damaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | mana ādīnāṃ pragrahādirūpatvaṃ kaṭhopaniṣadyuktam -- ātmānaṃ rathinaṃ viddhi śarīraṃ rathameva tu | buddhiṃ tu sārathiṃ viddhi manaḥ pragrahameva ca| idriyāṇi hayānāhurviṣayāṃsteṣu gocarān | iti mārgānityarthaḥ||23 1/2|| damarūpabahirindriyanigrahasādhyāmuparatimāha bāhyeti -- bāhyānālambanaṃ vṛttereṣoparatiruttamā || 24 || anvayaḥ (antaḥkaraṇa)vṛtteḥbāhyānālambanaṃ eṣā uttama uparatiḥ|| 24|| bhāṣyam -- taṭākodakasya taṭākacchidradvārā nirgatya yathā kṣtrādyātmanā pariṇāmaḥ, evamantasthasya manasaḥ śrotrādicchidradvārā bahirāgatya śabdādiviṣayākāreṇa pariṇāmarūpā vṛttirjāyate | nigṛhīteṣu ca bahirindriyeṣu antasthaṃ manaḥ na bāhyākāreṇa pariṇamata iti bhāvaḥ||24|| yadā bāhyaṃ nālambate cittaṃ tadā śītṣṇādidvandvasya apratīyamānatvāt karmakālādivaśāt tatprasaktāvapi tatsahanarūpā titikṣā siddhyatītyāha sahanamiti -- sahanaṃ sarva duḥkhānāṃ apratīkārapūrvakam | cintāvilāparahitaṃ sā titikṣā nigadyate ||25|| anvayaḥ sarvaduḥkhānām sahanaṃ apratīkārapūrvakaṃ cintāvilāparahitaṃ sā titikṣā nigadyate|| 25|| bhāṣyam -- kambalavyajanādibhiḥ śaityoṣṇyādiduḥkhapratīkāraḥ lokasiddhaḥ | tādṛśasāmagryabhāve kimasmābhirdīnaiḥ karaṇīyamiti cintā, pralāpaśca| vicārasādhanatitikṣāyāstathātvaṃ vyāvartayati apratīkārapūrvakaṃ cintāvilāparahitaṃ yatsahanaṃ sā titikṣeti | duḥkhānāṃ duḥkhahetuśītoṣṇādīnāmityarthaḥ| cintāvilāpādisahitasya manasaḥ vicārasya dūrāpāstatvāditi bhāvaḥ ||25|| idānīṃ vastūpalabdhyasādhāraṇakāraṇaṃ śraddhāṃ nirūpayati śāstrasyeti -- śāstrasya guruvākyasya satyabudhyāvadhāraṇā | sā śraddhā kathitā sadbhiryayā vastūpalabhyate ||26|| anvayaḥ śāstrasya guruvākyasya (ca) satyabuddhyavadhāraṇā sā sadbhiḥśraddhā (iti) kathitā yayā vastu upalabhyate|| 26|| bhāṣyam -- loke'pi āptavākye viśvāsābhāve naiva tadanusāreṇa pravartate puruṣaḥ vicārādau | kimutātīndriye śāstrārthe, ataḥ sā paramakāraṇam | uktaṃ hi gītāyāṃ aśraddhadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa | aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani || iti | yastāvat śānto dānta uparatastitikṣuśca sa eva brahmaikameva satyaṃ tadeva tvaṃ anyatsarvaṃ mithyā iti guruṇā vedāntaiśca bodhyamānaṃ vastu viśvasiti idamevameveti | nānyastādṛśasādhanahīnaḥ iti śraddhā tadanantaraṃ parigaṇitā guruvedāntavākyaviṣayiṇī | śāstraṃ tattvamasyādiśāstraṃ guruvākyaṃ tadanusāri nāsitvaṃ saṃsārī kintu nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāvaṃ paraṃ brahmaiva anyatsarvaṃ mithyā ityādi vākyaṃ tasya satyam abādhitārthabodhakam iti budhyā, avadhāraṇā dṛḍhaviśvāsaḥ , yayā vastūpalabhyate sā śradhā iti sadbhiḥ kathitetyanvayaḥ ||26|| etādṛśaśraddhāvataeva samādhānaṃ samyaksiddhyatīti tadanantaraṃ samādhānaṃ nirūpayati samyagiti -- samyagāsthāpanaṃ buddheḥ śuddhe brahmaṇi sarvadā | tatsamādhānamityuktaṃ na tu cittasya lālanam ||27|| anvayaḥ śuddhe brahmaṇi sarvadā samyagā buddheḥ sthāpanaṃ tat samādhānaṃ (iti)uktam tu na cittasya lālanam|| 27|| bhāṣyam -- yadyapi svalakṣye niyatāvasthārūpaśamāpekṣayā bhedo na lakṣyati īdṛśe samādhāne , tathāpi 'muhurmuhuḥ doṣadṛṣṭyā viṣayebhyo virajya svalakṣye niyatāvasthā ' ityanena yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram | tatastato niyamyaitat ātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet || iti gītoktarītyā śamāvasthāyāṃ prayatnaviśeṣo'pekṣyate saṃkalpavikalpātmakasya manasaḥ sthirīkaraṇe | ata evātra adhyavasāyātmikāyāḥ buddheḥ śuddhe brhmaṇi samyagāsthāpanaṃ sarvadā ityanena saṃkalpavikalpavinirmuktatvamantaḥkaraṇasya prakṛte kathitaṃ bhavati | ata eva manaḥśabdaṃ vihāya nirṇayātmakavṛttimadbuddhiśabdaḥ prāyoji| tatrāpi śuddhe brahmaṇīti nirguṇaṃ kathyate sarvopādhivinirmuktam | śamanirūpaṇāvasare svalakṣye niyatāvasthetyanena saguṇe niyatāvasthāne'pi śāntatvaṃ manaso vaktuṃ śakyam | śama iti sādhanaṃ kathyate , samādhānaṃ tasya phalaṃ tasyaiva paripāka iti yāvat | loke bālakā viśeṣato rudanti cet tadiṣṭaṃ datvā samādadhate janāḥ, tadvat manaso yatheṣṭaṃ viṣayamārgasañcaraṇaṃ na samādhānamityāha na tu cittasya lālanamiti | yadvā -- śubhāśubhābhyāṃ mārgābhyāṃ vahantī vāsanāsarit | pauruṣeṇa prayatnena yojanīyā śubhe pathi ||1|| aśubheṣu samāviṣṭaṃ śubheṣvevāvatārayet | svamanaḥpuruṣārthena balena balināṃ vara ||2|| aśubhāccālitaṃ yāti śubhaṃ tasmādapītarat | jantościttaṃ tu śiśuvat tasmāttaccālayed balāt ||3|| samatāsāntvanenāśu na drāgiti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | pauruṣeṇa prayatnena lālayeccittabālakam ||4|| iti vāsiṣṭharītyā cālanaṃ lālanaṃ vā śamādisādhanatvena pūrvamapekṣyate | na tu phalībhūtasamādhānāvasthāyāṃ , tadābhyāsaṃ vināpi śamādisampādanakāle kṛtaprayatnenaiva kṣīṇabāhyavāsanasya manasaḥ saguṇātpracyāvanamātrasya nirguṇe sthāpayitumapekṣitatvāt iti ||27|| etādṛśasādhanagaṇamaṇḍitasyaiva mumukṣutvaṃ sanbhavati nānyasyeti idānīṃ mumukṣutvamāha ahaṅkārādīti -- ahaṅkārādidehāntān bandhānajñā~kalpitān | svasvarūpāvabodhena moktumicchā mumukṣutā ||28|| anvayaḥ svasvarūpāvabodhena ahaṃkārādidehāntān bandhān ajñānakalpitān moktuṃ icchā (sā) mumukṣutā|| 28|| bhāṣyam -- antaḥkaraṇameteṣu cakṣurādiṣu varṣmaṇi | ahamityabhimānena tiṣṭhatyābhāsatejasā || ahaṅkāraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ ityuktyā citpratiphalanopetamantaḥkaraṇam ahaṅkāraḥ | yadvā bhoktā jīvo'haṅkāraḥ ānandamayakośanāmā, svātmanirūpaṇe -- suptigataissukhaleśaiḥ abhimanute sukhībhavāmīti | ānandakośanāmā so'ṅhaṃkāraḥ kathaṃ bhavedātmā iyuktatvāt | tasyāpyajñānakalpitatvaṃ manorūpopādhivaśādvikāratvaṃ ca gauṇaṃ vaktuṃ śakyam | tathā ca ānandakośaprabhṛtivijñānamayamanomayaprāṇamayānnamayāntān bandhān svarūpasākṣātkārātprāgātmatvena manyamānān svasvarūpāvabodhena moktuṃ punastatra yathā'hantā na syāt tathā vyaktuṃ bādhitumityarthaḥ | yā icchā sā mumukṣutā | svasvarūpāvabodhe hi "yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūt tatkena kaṃ paśyet " iti śrutyā svavyatiriktasya kasyāpi bhānābhāvena kośapañcakātmakabandhanivṛttiratyantamiti bhāvaḥ ||28|| iyaṃ tāvat mumukṣutā trividhā -- mandā madhyamā pravṛddhā ceti | mokṣasya nityasukharūpatve'pi sāṃsārikavāsanāvāsitātaḥkaraṇānāṃ mokṣecchaiva durlabhā | adhyātmaśāstraśravaṇakāle jātā sā na kāryamādadhāti| yadā puruṣaḥ śravaṇānantarajātavivekena viṣayeṣu sāṃsārikeṣu doṣān darśaṃ darśaṃ tatra vairāgyaṃ labdhvā vidhivatsaṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi, vicārārthaṃ gurūpasadanādau pravartate tadā adhyātmaśāstraśravaṇakāle jātā tātkālikyeva mumukṣutā mandeti nāmārhaiva madhyamatvaṃ prāpnoti | yathā yathā tīvraṃ vairāgyaṃ manaścopaśāntaṃ samādhitsati guruścasminprasīdati kṣipramayaṃ taratu bhavābdhrimiti tadā puruṣaḥ nityasukharūmokṣādanyanna kāmayate tatra vilambaṃ ca na sahata iti pravṛddhamumukṣuḥ mukhyādhikārī bhūtvā kṣipraṃ labhate phlamityāha mandeti -- mandamadhyamarūpā'pi vairāgyeṇa śamādinā | prasādena guroḥseyaṃ pravṛddhā sūyate phalam ||29|| anvayaḥ mandamadhyamarūpāpi sūyate phalam(iti)sā iyaṃ pravṛddhā guroḥ prasādena vairāgyeṇa śamādina || 29|| bhāṣyam -- itthaṃ ca mumukṣāyā mokṣecchārūpatve'pi yadā sā pravṛddhā tadaiva phalaṃ prasūta ityanena tatpravṛddhayarthaṃ viṣayavairāgyaśamādiṣaṭkaguruprasādalābhārthaṃ prayatnaḥ kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇtyuktaṃ bhavati ||29|| sādhanacatuṣṭayamadhye dvitīyaturīyasattve sarvaṃ tatrāsti nānyathetyāha | vairāgyamiti -- vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ tīvraṃ yasya tu vidyate | tasminnevārthavantaḥ syuḥ phalavantaḥ śamādayaḥ ||30|| anvayaḥ śamādayaḥ arthavantaḥ syuḥ phalavantaḥtasmin eva yasya tu tīrvaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ (asti)|| 30|| bhāṣyam -- arthavantaśśamādaya ityatra śamādaya ityasya śamādiśabdā ityarthaḥ |tasminpuruṣe śamādayassantīti vyavahārassārthaka iti bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ śānto dāntaḥ ityādiśabdabhāk tīvravairāgyavān tīvramumukṣutāvāṃścetyarthaḥ tīvramumukṣutvasyaiva śamādiphalatvāt | yadi tīvramumukṣutvaṃ tadā sādhanaṃ vinā phalālābhātkāryātkāraṇamanumīyata iti śamādimattvaṃ tasya suvacam | evaṃ śamādisādhanaṃ tīvravairāgyaṃ yadā tasmin jñāyate , sādhane sati phalāvaśyambhāvāt śamādimatvaṃ tasminnavarjanīyam | itthaṃ ca śamādisādhane sati tīvravairāgyaśamādiphale ca tīvramumukṣutve svasādhanaphalamadhyavarti svayaṃ nirapavādamiti bhāvaḥ | tīvravairāgye śamādiśbdāḥ arthavantaḥ, tīvramumukṣutve śamādayaḥ phalavantaḥ iti vibhāgaḥ | śamādīnāmitarāntaḥkaraṇaniṣṭhānāṃ durjñānatvāt kāraṇakāryābhyāmavagantavyamuktam | svayamapi puruṣeṇa śāntyādikaṃ samapādīti kathaṃ jñeyamityuktau puṣkalakāraṇe tīvravairāgye viśiṣṭaphale tīvramumukṣutve ca sati tatheti svasmin parasmiṃśca kāraṇakārye jñāpake iti bhāvaḥ| kākasya viṣṭhāvadasahyabuddhirbhogyeṣu sā tīvraviraktiriṣyate | viraktitīvratvanidhānamāhuḥ bhogyeṣu doṣekṣaṇameva santaḥ || iti vairāgye tīvratvaṃ tatsādhanaṃ ca kathitaṃ sarvavedāntasiddhāntasārasaṅgrahe | mumukṣutve tīvratvaṃ pravṛddhatvameva | tattu prāgabhihitam ||30|| etayormandatā yatra viraktatvamumukṣayoḥ | marau salilavattatra śamāderbhānamātratā ||31|| anvayaḥ yatra viraktatvamumukṣayoḥ etayoḥ mandatā (asti) tatra marau salīlavat śamādeḥ bhānamātratā|| 31|| bhāṣyam -- yatra yasminpuruṣe etayoḥ viraktatvamumukṣayoḥ mandatā tātkālikatvaṃ marau salilavat, nidāghasamaye marubhūmau caṇḍakiraṇasamparke dūrasthasya tatra jalamastīti bhrāntirbhavati na jalalābhaḥ tatra naiva pipāsānivṛttiḥ, pratyuta śrāntasya tatra jaladhiyā jalārthaṃ gamanena śramādhikyameva, tadvattīvravairāgyamumukṣatvayorabhāve marusalilavat śamādestatra bhānamātratā na śamādiphalaṃ tasya , nāpītaraiḥ śānta ityādiśabdairvyavahiyate ca iti bhāvaḥ ||31|| evaṃ sarveṣāṃ vedāntānāmadvitīyabrahmaṇi pratyagabhinne nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāve tātparyanirṇayānukūlavyāpararūpaśravaṇātmakabrahmavicārādhikāriṇ viśeṣaṇāni vivekādīni nirūpya ātmasākṣātkārasākṣātsādhanaṃ bhaktiṃ pūrvoktavicārasādhyāmāha -- mokṣeti | mokṣakāraṇasāmagryāṃ bhaktireva garīyasī | svasvarūpānusandhānaṃ bhaktirityabhidhīyate ||32|| anvayaḥ (eteṣāṃ) mokṣakāraṇasāmagryāṃ bhaktiḥeva garīyasī (tasmāt) svasvarūpānusandhānaṃ (eva) bhaktiḥ iti abhidhīyate|| 32|| bhāṣyam -- svasvarūpānusandhānamiti nididhyāsanamucyate | tasyaiva sākṣātkāraṃ prati sākṣātsādhanatvāt | śrutyācāryopadeśena ' sa ātmā tattvamasi' iti śrutaḥyo'rthaḥ tava svarūpaṃ brahma tadeva tvamiti, tadanusandhānaṃ tadbhāvanādhārā vijātīyapratyayātiraskṛtasajātīya pratyayapravāharūpā sākṣātkāre asādhāraṇaṃ kāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ| śamadīnāṃ vicāradvārakanididhyāsanadvārākāraṇatvaṃ jñāne, asya tu sākṣāditi bhāvaḥ| ata eva mokṣasya kāraṇaṃ abhivyañjakaṃ yajjñānaṃ tatsāmagryāṃ tatsādhanasamudāyamadhye bhaktireva garīyasī sākṣātkāraṇatvādityuktam | sā ca sāmagrī vivekādinidhyāsanāntā ||32|| apareṣāṃ matamāha | svātmatattvānusandhānaṃ bhaktirityapare jaguḥ ||321/2 || anvayaḥ bhaktiḥ svātmatattvānusandhānaṃ iti apare jaguḥ || 321/2|| bhāṣyam -- svātmanaḥ svasya jīvasya tatvānusandhānam | tasya bhāvastattvam tatpadavācyārthatvam paramātmattvamityarthaḥ| tasyānusandhānaṃ, vāstavikabhedasattve'pi abhedenopāsanam ahaṅgrahopāsanamiti yāvat | tat bhaktiriti apare jaguḥ iti bhedabuddhipurassarāyāḥ bhrāntirūpāyā asyāḥ mukhyabhaktitvaṃ nāstīti sūcitam ||321/2|| pūrvoktasādhanasampannasya kṛtyamāha ukteti -- uktasādhanasampannaḥ tatvajijñāsurātmanaḥ upasīded guruṃ prājñaṃ yasmād bandhavimokṣaṇam||331/2|| anvayaḥ (yaḥ)uktasādhanasaṃpannaḥ ātmanaḥ tattvajijñāsuḥ yasmāt bandhavimokṣaṇam guruṃ prājñāṃ upasīdet || 33|| bhāṣyam -- uktasādhanasampannaḥ uktāni vicārasādhanatvena kathitāni yāni vivekādīni sādhanāni taiḥ sampannaḥ yuktaḥ , pumāniti śeṣaḥ | ātmanaḥ svasya tattvaṃ jñātumicchuḥ svayāthātmyajñānakāmaḥ upasīdet śaraṇaṃ gacchet, kam ? gurumupadeśakam | kīdṛśam? prājñaṃ ,prakṛṣṭā niratiśayā jñā avagatiḥ prajñā brahmasākṣātkāraḥ | brahmatmanoḥ śodhitayorekabhāvāvagāhinī | nirvikalpā ca cinmātrā vṛttiḥ prajñeti kathyate iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | sāsyāstīti prajñaḥ sa eva prājñaḥ , taṃ brahmaniṣṭhamityarthaḥ | tena svasya phalamāha || yasmādyādṛśaguroḥ sakāśāt , bandhavimokṣaṇaṃ bandhasya ajñānakalpitasya ahaṅkārādidehāntasya vimokṣaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇaparityāgaḥ iti | tādṛśagurūpasadane tadupadeśajanyasvayāthātmyajñānena bandhanivṛttirūpamokṣaḥ sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ ||331/2|| tādṛśaṃ guruṃ lakṣayati, śrotriya ityādinā -- śrotriyo'vṛjino'kāmahato yo brahmaviduttamaḥ | brahmaṇyuparataḥ śānto nirindhana ivānalaḥ ||341/2 || anvayaḥ yaḥ śrotriyaḥ avṛjinaḥ akāmahataḥ brahmavittamaḥ brahmaṇi uparataḥ śāntaḥ nirindhanaḥ iva analaḥ||34|| bhāṣyam -- 'śrotriyaśchando'dhīte' iti pāṇininā'nuśiṣṭatvāt adhītopaniṣatka ityarthaḥ |upaniṣadamadhītya kṛtatadarthavicārasyaiva sākṣātkārahetutvāt | avṛjinaḥ niṣpāpa ityarthaḥ | nāvirato duścaritāt nāśānto nāsamāhitaḥ | nāśāntamānaso vāpi prajñānenainamāpnuyāt || iti śruteḥ | tatra kāraṇamāha akāmahata iti | kāmena viṣayāśayā hataḥ kāmahataḥ abhāsitasvasvarūpa ityarthaḥ | na kāmahataḥ akāmahataḥ yastāvatsvarūpaṃ ānandaṃ na jānāti sa eva bahirānando'stīti taṃ prāptuṃ kadācitpāpamapi kuryāt | asya tāvat brahmavittamasya sākṣātkriyamāṇasvarūpānandatvāt viṣayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ | rasavarjaṃ raso'psya paraṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate iti gītoktarītyā nivṛttarāgatvarūpākāmahatatvaṃ sidhyatyeveti niṣpāpatvaṃ tasmin | kāmasyaiva pāpahetutvāt | taduktam gītāsu -- atha kena prayukto'yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ | anichannapi vārṣṇeya balādiva niyojitaḥ || ityarjunena pṛṣṭo bhagavānāha kāma eṣakrodha eṣa rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ | mahāśano mahāpāpmā viddhayenamiha vairiṇam ityādi | brahmaṇyuparataḥ brahmaṇi vilīnamaskaḥ ata eva nirindhana anala iva śāntaḥ , yathā indhanābhāve agniḥ śāntaḥ jvālāśūnyaḥ bhāti tathā anālambita bāhyavṛttitvāt śāntaḥ nirguṇe brahmaṇi pariniṣṭhitacittatvāt śāntaḥ nirvikāra ityarthaḥ | atra śrtriyatvādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ vyāvartakatvaṃ nāsti, brahmavittame aśrotriyatvasya pāpasya kāmahatatvasya ca asambhāvitatvāt , kantu vastusattayā teṣāṃ tādṛśagurujñāpakatvaṃ ,sambhavatīti svarūpalakṣaṇatmeva mantavyam ||34 1/2|| ahetukadayāsindhurbandhurānamatāṃ satām ||35|| anvayaḥ (yaḥ)ahetukadayāsindhuḥsatāmaṃ ānamatāṃ bandhuḥ ||35|| bhāṣyam -- na vidyate heturyasyāḥ sā ahetukī tādṛśī yā dayā paraduḥkhaprahāṇecchā tasyāḥ siṃdhuḥ āśraya ityarthaḥ | itarasya dayālorapi dayā anyatra duḥkhadarśanena svasyāpi jātaduḥkhatvāt | tannirāsārthamahetuketi | asya tu jñānamahimnā svato vā parato vā duḥkhaprasakteḥ kevalaṃ janāstarantu saṃsāravārdhiṃmiti icchā paraṃ vyutthānakāle iti bhāvaḥ | bandhuḥ duḥkhahāraka ityarthaḥ | keṣām ? ānamatāṃ satāṃ prahvībhavatāṃ satpuruṣāṇāmityanena śiṣyasya lakṣaṇaṃ parijñāyaiva te upadiśantīti sūcitam | śrūyate kila tatra nāsūyakāyānṛjave śaṭhāya, idamaśiṣyāya no deyam ityādi | smaryate ca gītāyām idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana | nācāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati || idamapusadanaṃ samīpagamanaṃ -- tamārādhya guruṃ bhaktyā prahvaḥ praśrayasevanaiḥ | prasannaṃ tamanuprāpya pṛcched jñātavyamātmanaḥ ||36|| anvayaḥ tamaṃ guruṃ bhaktyā ārādhya prahvapraśrayasevanaiḥ prasannaṃ tamaṃ anuprāpya ātmanaḥ jñātavyaṃ pṛcchet || 36|| bhāṣyam -- bhaktiḥ pūjyeṣvanurāgaḥ mānasadharmaḥ , tayā prahvaḥ tadvyaṃñjakākāraviśiṣṭaḥ namrakāyaḥ baddhāñjalipuṭaḥ, praśrayasevanaiḥ praśrayaśca sevanāni ca praśrayasevanāni tairityarthaḥ | tatra praśrayaḥ vinītavāktvaṃ sevanāni sāṣṭāṅganamaskāratatpādasaṃvahanataduktakaraṇādīni taistamārādhya saṃsevya ,ṛjvyā tayā sevayā prasanna svābhimukhaṃ taṃ anuprāpya yathāsamayanirdeśaṃ tatsannidhau yathāvidhi sthitvā ātmanaḥ jñātavyaṃ yajjijñāsitaṃ ātmayāthātmyaviṣaye tatpṛcchet | bhaktyā prahvaḥ praśrayasevanairārādhya ityanena ārādhayituḥ manasi vacasi kāye ca śuddhatvarūpatrikaraṇaśuddhiruktā ||36|| bhaktipurassaravācikārādhanaprakāraṃ dayayā darśayati bhagavān jijñāsubhyaḥ svāminnamaste ityādinā tathā vadantamityantam -- svāminnamaste natalokabandho kāruṇyasindho patitaṃ bhavābdhau | māmuddharātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā'tikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā ||37|| anvayaḥ (he) svāmin namaste natalokabandho kāruṇyasindho bhavābdhau patitaṃ māṃ uddharā (tava) ātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā|| 37|| bhāṣyam -- natalokabandho natānāṃ kṛtanatīnāṃ lokānāṃ janānāṃ bandhuḥ duḥkhamocakaḥ tasya sambuddhau natalokabandho , svāmin prabho, te tubhyaṃ namaḥ, prahvībhāvaḥ astviti śeṣaḥ | yatastvaṃ natalokaduḥkhamocakaḥ atastvāṃ duḥkhamuktyai namāmīti bhāvaḥ| tatra hetumāha kāruṇyasindho iti sambodhanena | vivṛtametat ahetukadayāsindhurityatra | svakīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ nivedayati bhavābdhau patitaṃ , janmarārogamaraṇānarthasaṅkule saṃsārasamudre patitamityarthaḥ| idānīṃ tannivṛttiṃ prārthayate māmuddhareti | janmādibandhanirmuktaṃ kurvityarthaḥ | tatra sādhanaṃ yācate ātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyeti | svakīyalocanaprāntenetyarthaḥ |brahmasākṣātkāranirdhūtasakalamalasya bhavataḥ pavitrakaṭākṣapāte sakalapāpanirmukto'haṃ saṃsārasāgaraṃ tarāmīti bhāvaḥ| uktaṃ hi yasyānubhavaparyantā buddhiḥsatve pravartate | taddṛṣṭigocarāssarve mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || iti | etena śiṣyeṇa gurossākṣātpuraḥ na stheyamiti vinayaprakāro darśito bhavati | kiñca sampūrṇāvalokanaṃ kaṭākṣapāta eva | atastatkāmaye ityapi bhāvaḥ | nityaśuddhabrahmānandamagnasya manasaḥ cakṣuḥprāntadvārā pūrṇatayā mayi pāte sarvathā'pi pūtaḥ duḥkhavimukto bhaveyamahamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā ātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā svakīyasānugrahavīkṣaṇenetyarthaḥ | ṛjvyā svabhāvasaralayā, tadviśeṣaṇena yathā loke agādhajalapatitaḥ ṛjvīṃ rajjuṃ yaṣṭiṃ vā avalambya uddhṛto bhavati tathā'ha bhavatkaṭākṣaṃ dīrdhadīrdhamavalambya saṃsārābdheruddhṛto bhavāmīti bhāvaḥ vyañjitaḥ| sūryamaṇḍalādvā dīpādvā kiraṇāḥ puñjībhūya rajjuvadyathā niṣkrāmanti tathā cakṣuṣo'pi tejastvāt niṣkrāntā raśmayaḥ etasmin saṅkrāntāḥ brahmaniṣṭhamanassaṃyuktatvādenamuddharantīti bhāvaḥ | atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā atyantaṃ kāruṇyaṃ atikāruṇyaṃ tadeva sudhā, sakalatāpahārakatvāt sudheti rūpyate| sudhā nāmāmṛtaṃ, tasyāḥ abhito vṛṣṭiḥ yasyāṃ dṛṣṭyāṃ sā atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭiḥ tayā atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā | amṛtābhivarṣaṇena puruṣaḥ jarāmaraṇādivarjito bhavatīti prasiddham | yuddhe mṛtā vānarā indrakāritāmṛtavarṣaṇena ujjīvitā iti rāmāyaṇe prasiddham | tādṛśāmṛtasyaiva tathātve brahmaniṣṭhānukampāmṛtavarṣaṇadṛṣṭiḥ asaṅkucitajarāmaraṇādivarjitatvaṃ dāsyatīti bhāvaḥ ||37|| svoddharaṇe vilambamasahiṣṇuḥ svakīyatīvramumukṣutvaṃ prakaṭīkaroti durvāreti -- durvārasaṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ dodhūyamānaṃ duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ | bhītaṃ prapannaṃ paripāhi mṛtyoḥ śaraṇyamanyaṃ yadahaṃ na jāne ||38|| anvayaḥ yat anyaṃ śaraṇyaṃ ahaṃ na jāne(tasmāt) durvārasaṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ dodhūyamānaṃ mṛtyoḥbhītaṃ prapannaṃ(māṃ) paripāhi || 38|| bhāṣyam -- saṃsāra eva davāgniḥ sarvaśo vyāpya tāpahetutvāt vanānalaḥ , saḥ bhavadīyasadupadeśajanitajñānaṃ vinā na vārayituṃ śakya iti durvāraḥ| vārayituṃ svayamaśakya ityarthaḥ | dirvāraścāsau saṃsāradavāgniḥ tena taptaṃ dagdhaṃ , vanānalasya vātasahitatve bahuvyāpya tāpakatvaṃ prasiddham| tathā duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ duradṛṣṭāni pāpāni tānyeva vātāḥ pratikūlavāyavaḥ taiḥ dodhūyamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ kampyamānaṃ, anukūlaścedvātaḥ enamanyatra nayet , pratikūlastu vātaḥ, agnau pātayati agniṃ vā asmin | evaṃ davāgnitaptasya amṛtavarṣaṇe tāpamokṣo bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇa pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyeti viśeṣaṇaṃ dattam | tatra bahuvrīhimakṛtvā dṛṣṭyā karaṇena atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā sudhābhivarṣaṇena ityapi vaktuṃ śakyate | tena davāgnitaptaṃ māṃ mṛtyoḥ paripāhītyanvayaḥ | itthaṃ ca svakīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā māmuddhareti pūrvamanvayaḥ | tayā apikāruṇyasudhābhivarṣaṇena saṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ māṃ mṛtyḥ paripāhītyuttaratrānvayaḥ | mṛtyorbhītaṃ , prapannaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ, māṃ mṛtyoḥ paripāhītyubhayatrānvayaḥ | bhavadanugrahādātmajñāne sati mama śarīrotkramaṇarūpamaraṇaṃ na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | "natasya prāṇā utkrāmanti atraiva samavanīyante" iti śruteḥ | tathāca "dhṛvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca " ityuktatvāt maraṇābhāve janmābhāvasya siddhatvāt janmamaraṇapravāharūpasaṃsārāt mukto bhavāmi bhavadanugrahe iti bhāvaḥ |svasyānanyaśaraṇatvaṃ gurvābhimukhyāya prakaṭayati śaraṇyamanyaṃ yadahaṃ na jāne iti | bhavadanyaṃ madrakṣakaṃ yat yasmāt ahaṃ na jāne | ato'nanyaśaraṇo'yaṃ nodāsitavya iti bhāvaḥ | ||38|| ślokadvayena bhavādṛśāṃ asmāsu karuṇā nirvyājaivetyāha śāntā iti | śāntā mahānto nivasanti santo vasantavallokahitaṃ carantaḥ | tīrṇāssvayaṃ bhīmabhavārṇavaṃ janānahetunānyānapi tārayantaḥ ||39|| ayaṃ svabhāvassvata eva yatparaśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ mahātmanām | sudhāṃśureṣa svayamarkakarkaśaprabhābhitaptāmavati kṣitiṃ kila ||40|| anvayaḥ śāntāḥ mahāntaḥsantaḥ nivasanti vasantavat lokahitaṃ carantaḥ bhīmabhavārṇavaṃ svayaṃ tīrṇāḥ ahetunā anyān janān api tārayantaḥ|| 39|| ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ mahātmanām svata eva yat paraśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ (yathā) arkakarkaśaprabhābhitapta kṣitiṃ sudhāṃśureṣa svayaṃ avati kila|| 40|| bhāṣyam -- varṣāsu vṛṣṭibādhā , grīṣme tāpaḥ , śaradi prārambhe sukhaṃ , namāsadvaye kārtikāntimabhāgasya yamadaṃṣṭrātvakīrtanāt , hemantaśiśirayośśaityaṃ, sugandhikusumākaraḥ vasantartuḥ kātsnryena lokasya sukhaṃ janayatīti vasantavadityuktaṃ tadā varṣatāpaśaityarogādīnāmabhāvāt | sa ṛtuḥ yathā sukhameva janayati tathā lokasya sukhameva tanvānāḥ śāntāḥ nirvikāramanaskāḥ ata eva mahāntaḥ, aparicchinnabrahmasākṣātkāravantaḥ, ata eva tādṛśasadbramābhedena santaḥ " brahmavit brahmaiva bhavatīti śruteḥ, svayaṃ bhīmaḥ bhayaṃkaraḥ yaḥ bhavārṇavaḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ taṃ tīrṇāḥ asaṃsāriṇa ityarthaḥ| svasya āptakāmatvena prayojanābhāvāt ahetunā hetuṃ vinā,anyānapi tārayantaḥ bhavāmbhodhimagnāniti bhāvaḥ| hetuṃ vinā kathaṃ teṣāṃ tattāraṇe nahi svabhāve kāraṇaṃ gaveṣaṇīyam | nahi śarkarāyāṃ mādhuryaṃ kiṃ nimittamiti praśno yujyate tatra tasya svābhāvikatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|paraśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ pareṣāṃ yaśśramaḥ duḥkhaṃ tasyāpanodaḥ nivāraṇaṃ tatra pravaṇaṃ bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ pravaṇabhāvaḥ pravaṇatā saktatā vaiyagryamityarthaḥ| iti yat ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ mahātmanāṃ svata eva | parapreraṇādikaṃ tatra nāpekṣyata ityarthaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha sudhāṃśurityādinā | arkakarkaśaprabhābhitaptāṃ arkasya sūryasya yā karkaśā tīkṣṇā prabhā prakāśaḥ tayā abhitaḥ taptāṃ kṣitiṃ bhūmiṃ, sudhāṃśuḥ amṛtakiraṇaścandraḥ eṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ samīpavartī , svayaṃ parāpreritaḥ avati rakṣati, kileti prasiddhau ||40|| evaṃ vinītaveṣeṇa tadanusāriṇyā vācā tadabhivyaṃjitabhaktyāca ārtaḥ ananyaśaraṇo'yaṃ sarvathā rakṣaṇīya ityabhiprāyeṇa svābhimukhaṃ svātmānaṃ sānugrahānukampāmṛtavarṣikaṭākṣaiḥ pāvayantaṃ deśikottamaṃ svabandhamocakopadeśāya dhairyeṇa prārthayate | brahmānandetyādinā | brahmānandarasānubhūtikalitaiḥ pūtaiḥ suśītaiḥ sitaiḥ yuṣmadvākkalaśojjhitaiḥ śrutisukhaiḥ vākyāmṛtaiḥ secaya | saṃtaptaṃ bhavatāpadāvadahanajvālābhirenaṃ prabho dhanyāste bhavadīkṣaṇakṣaṇagateḥ pātrīkṛtāḥ svīkṛtāḥ ||41|| anvayaḥ he prabho brahmānandarasānubhūtikalitaiḥ pūtaiḥ suśītaiḥsitaiḥyuṣmad vāk kalaśa ujjhitaiḥ śrutisukhaiḥvākyāmṛtaiḥsecaya bhavatāpadāvadahanajvālābhiḥsaṃtaptaṃ enaṃ bhavadīkṣaṇakṣaṇagateḥpātrīkṛtāḥ svīkṛtāḥte dhanyāḥ|| 41|| bhāṣyam -- he prabho sarvaśakta, bhavadīkṣaṇakṣaṇagateḥ bhavatāṃ yadīkṣaṇaṃ dayārdrvilokanaṃ , tasya kṣaṇagateḥ kṣaṇaprāpteḥ, pātrīkṛtāḥ āspadībhūtāḥ, yadvā bhavatāṃ yadīkṣaṇaṃ nayanaṃ tasya kṣaṇagateḥ kṣaṇasaṃyogasya pātrīkṛtāḥ āśrayībhūtāḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ vā bhavannetrapātalakṣyā iti yāvat | ata eva svīkṛtāḥ ātmīyatvena kṛtāḥ ye puruṣāḥ te dhanyāḥ kṛtārthāḥ | tasmādahamapi bhavatkaṭākṣeṇa pātitatamāḥ pātitatamaśca dhanyo'smi | atikṣipraṃ sāṃsārikāgnitāpaṃ śiśamayiṣuḥ evaṃ prārthaye iti sūcayati | "śreyasi kena tṛpyate" iti nyāyena kaṭākṣapātraṃ māṃ svīkṛtaṃ bhavatāpadāvadahanajvālābhiḥ bhavasya tāpaḥ bhavatāpaḥ , saṃsāraśokaḥ sa eva dāvadahanaḥ vanāgni, tajjvālābhiḥ saṃtaptaṃ atyantadagdhaṃ, enaṃ parovartinaṃ , māṃ brahmānanda eva rasa iva āsvadyata iti rasaḥ, tadanubhūtikalitaiḥ tadanubhavamiśraiḥ , ata eva pūtaiḥ sakalakalmaṣahārakatvena pavitraiḥ "na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyata " iti smṛteḥ | tādṛśajñānavat vākyānāṃ sakala -- pāpāpahārakajñānopadeśa rūpatvena pūtatvam | suśītaiḥ āntarāṇāṃ ādhyātmikādhidaivikādhibhautika tāpānāṃ nāśakatvāt | sitaiḥ rajastamomārganivartanadvārā sattvamārgaikaprāpakatvena nirmalaiḥ | yuṣmadvākkalaśojjhitaiḥ yuṣmākaṃ vāk yuṣmadvāk , vāgindriyaṃ tatsthānaṃ mukhaṃ vā sa eva kalaśaḥ ghaṭaḥ tato nirgalanti vākyāmṛtānīti , tena ujjhitaiḥ visṛṣṭaiḥ, śrutisukhaiḥ karṇānandāyakaiḥ, vākyāmṛtaiḥ vākyānyevāmṛtāni tairityarthaḥ| secaya māṃ sicetyarthaḥ | svārthe ṇic | pūtatvaṃ suśītatvaṃ sitatvaṃ kalaśojjhitatvaṃ vākyeṣvamṛte cāviśiṣṭamiti vākyānyamṛtatvena rūpitāni | pūtatve hetuḥ brahmānandarasānubhūtikalitairiti, śrutisukhairiti śravaṇakāle'pi ānandakarairityanena tadarthamanusaṃdhāya yadyanubhava utpadyeta tādātvikaḥ ānandaḥ kimu vaktavya iti bhāvaḥ ||41|| pūrvaṃ bhītaṃ prapannaṃ ityatroktāṃ bhītiṃ spaṣṭayati sahasā svasminnanugrahasidhyartham | kathamityādinā | kathaṃ tareyaṃ bhavasindhumetaṃ kā vā gatirme katamostyupāyaḥ | jāne na kiṃcitkṛpayāva māṃ prabho saṃsāraduḥkhakṣatimātanuṣva ||42|| anvayaḥ etaṃ bhavasindhuṃ (ahaṃ)kathaṃ tareyaṃ ?me kā vā gatiḥ? katamaḥ asti upāyaḥ?(ahaṃ)kiñcit na jāne, kṛpayāḥ māṃ ava,he prabho saṃsāraduḥkhakṣatiṃ ātanuṣva|| 42|| bhāṣyam -- etaṃ bahuvidhadurvāraduḥkhajālajaṭilaṃ bhavasiṃdhuṃ kathaṃ tareyam | evameva yadi varteya me kāvā gatiḥ ? mayā kiṃ tāvatprāpyam ? sarvathā duḥkhameveti bhāvaḥ| ataḥ katamostyupāyaḥ etadbhavasindhutaraṇe kovopāyo'sti? ahaṃ tāvat kiṃcidapi na jāne | māmava evaṃ bhītaṃ paripāhi |avanaṃ spaṣṭam prārthayate saṃsāraduḥkhakṣatimātanuṣveti | sāṃsārikaśokaṃ samūlaghātaṃ jahītyarthaḥ ||42|| idānīṃ guroḥ kartavyamupadiśati, tathetyādinā, ślokadvayena | tathāvadantaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ svaṃ saṃsāradāvānalatāpataptam | nirīkṣya kāruṇyarasārdradṛṣṭyā dadyādabhītiṃ sahasā mahātmā ||43|| vidvānsa tasmā upasattimīyuṣe mumukṣave sādhu yathoktakāriṇe | praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya tattvopadeśaṃ kṛpayaiva kuryāt ||44|| anvayaḥ tathā vadantaṃ saṃsāradāvānalatāpataptam svaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ kāruṇyarasārdradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣya mahātmā(guruḥ)sahasā abhītiṃ dadyād || 43|| sa vidvān upasattiṃ īyuṣe mumukṣave sādhu yathoktakāriṇe tasmā praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya tattvopadeśaṃ kṛpayā kuryāt eva || 44|| bhāṣyam -- tathāvadantamityuktyā vāgvyāpāreṇa tadīyādhikārasya āntarasya samyajjñātuṃ śakyatvāt adhikāriṇaṃ jñātvaiva abhayadānopadeśādikaṃ gurubhiḥ kartavyamiti dyotitam | saṃsāradāvānalatāpataptaṃ, svaṃ svātmānaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ rakṣakatvena matvā prāptaṃ, kāruṇyarasārdradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣya, mahātmā akṣudrabuddhiḥ, guruḥ sahasā'bhītiṃ dadyādityanena bhītāḥ sahasā bhītyā mocanīyā iti vyañjitam | abhayadānena nivṛttabhītereva puruṣasya upadiṣṭārthagrahaṇādau sāmarthyaṃ sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | bhītasya bhayaṃ śaktena bahukālaṃ na sthāpanīyaṃ iti ca sahasetyuktam | bhītasyābhayadānaṃ prathamataḥ kartavyamityuktvā adhikārānusāreṇa upadeśaḥ anantarakālika iti bodhayati vidvānityādinā | sa vidvān brahmavittamo deśikaḥ , upasattimīyuṣe vidhivatsamīpaṃ gatāya mumukṣave mokṣaṃ kāmayamānāya, sādhuyathoktakāriṇe samyagvihitānuṣṭhātre | etena śiṣṭatvamuktam | "nāvirato duścaritāt nāśānto nāsamāhitaḥ | nāśāntamānaso vāpi prajñānenainamāpnuyāt " ityuktatvāt | śrotriyatvaṃ avṛjinatvaṃ mokṣakāmavyatiriktakāmaśūnyatvaṃ ca śiṣye avekṣaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ| praśāntacittāya dehādibrahmaparyantabhogyavastuno virajya , svalakṣye niyatāvasthitamanaskāya, śamānvitāya nigṛhītabahirindriyāya, etena śamādiṣaṭkamuktam | adhikāriviśeṣaṇam | tasmai vairāgyādi guṇagaṇamaṇḍitāya, tattvopadeśaṃ kṛpayā tadīyaduḥkhaprahāṇecchayā āptakāmasya spṛhāntarābhāvāt kuryādevetyevakāro bhinnakramaḥ | adhikāriṇi labdhe nodāsitavyam , pātre dattā brahmavidyā lokānugrahārthaṃ pratiṣṭhitābhavatīti bhāvaḥ | itthaṃ ca sarvānarthahetubhūtāvidyānivartakabrahmavidyāpāraṃparyāvicchedaḥ svaśiṣyamocanaṃ ca upadeśasya phalam | tatra guruśiṣyasaṃvādarūpeṇa prakaraṇapraṇayanaṃ sulabhatayā tattvasya śrotṛbuddhyārohāya |ata eva kilākhyātyākhyāyikāṃ tatra tatra śrutirapi | tena gurulakṣaṇaṃ śiṣyalakṣaṇaṃ praṣṭavyādyaṃśāḥ sarve anāyāsena asmābhiḥ jñātuṃ śakyante iti ||44|| paramakāruṇiko guruḥ śiṣyeṇa "kathaṃ tareyaṃ bhavasindhumetaṃ " ityādinā darśitāṃ bhītiṃ jhaṭiti nināśayiṣurāha | mābhaiṣṭeti | mābhaiṣṭa vidvaṃstava nāstyapāyaḥ saṃsārasiṃdhostaraṇestyupāyaḥ | yenaiva yātā yatayosya pāraṃ tameva mārgaṃ tava nirdiśāmi||45|| anvayaḥ (he)vidvān mābhaiṣṭa tava apāyaḥnāsti saṃsārasindhoḥ taraṇe asti upāyaḥyatayaḥ asya pāraṃ yenaiva yātā tameva mārgaṃ tava nirdiśāmi|| 45|| bhāṣyam -- he vidvan bhavān mābhaiṣṭa , bhavato bhayaṃ mābhūditi sahasā abhītirdattā |vidvanniti sambodhayan vivekādikaṃ saṃpādya gurukaruṇāṃ vinā duḥkhataraṇaṃ na bhavatīti māṃ prāptastvaṃ jñātavyaṃ jānīṣa eva iti sūcayati , tādṛśasya tava sādhuyathoktakāriṇaḥ nāstyapāyaḥ "nahi kalyāṇakṛtkaścit durgatiṃtāta gacchati " iti smṛteḥ | ataḥ kathaṃ tareyam ,kāvā gatiriti maiva bhaiṣīrityarthaḥ | evaṃ mā bhaiṣṭa tava kalyāṇakartuḥ apāyo nāstīti tamāśvāsya katamo'styupāyaḥ ityasya uttaramāha saṃsārasiṃdhostaraṇe'styupāya iti | tatra samyagviśvāsotpatyarthaṃ tamupāyaṃ sapramāṇaṃ kathayati | yenaiva mārgeṇa asya saṃsārasindhoḥ pāraṃ antaṃ yatayaḥ prayatnaśīlāḥ saṃnyāsinaḥ , yātāḥ tameva mārgaṃ tava nirdiśāmi upadiśāmītyarthaḥ ||45|| tādṛśamārgaśuśrūṣāyāmautkaṭyasidhyarthaṃ punarapi sāmānyarūpeṇaiva upāyaṃ nirdiśati |astīti| astyupāyo mahānkaścit saṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ | tena tīrtvā bhavāmbhodhiṃ paramānandamāpsyasi ||46|| anvayaḥ saṃsārabhayanāśanaḥmahān kaścit asti upāyaḥ tena bhavāmbhodhiṃ tīrtvā paramānandaṃ āpsyasi || 46|| bhāṣyam -- saṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ mahān bahvāyāsasādhyasādhanasādhyaḥ kaścidupāyo'sti, tena vakṣyamāṇopāyena bhavāmbhodhiṃ dustaraṃ saṃsārasāgaraṃ tīrtvā tanmūlabhūtāṃ avidyāṃ bhaṃktvā paramānandaṃ niravadhikaṃ śāśvataṃ saṃtoṣaṃ, āpsyasi lapsyase ityarthaḥ | tena duḥkhanivṛttireva tvayā
