anvayavyatirekasahacāragrahādhīnā teṣāṃ vivekādīnāṃ sanniṣṭhāparaparyāyaphalaparyantabrahmajijñāsākāraṇatvāvagatiḥ ityuktam | manīṣibhiḥ kathitānīti | tatra manīṣitvaṃ ca śrutitātparyajñānavattvam | śrutyavalambanābhāve etādṛśādhikāriviśeṣaṇānāṃ durjñānatvāt | tādṛśāśca manīṣiṇaḥ bādarāyaṇaprabhṛtayaḥ| te kila "athāto brahmajijñāsā" iti sūtraghaṭakāthaśabdena sādhanacatuṣṭayasampattyānantaryaṃ sūtrayantaḥ brahmajijñāsādhikāriṇamevaṃ vidhaṃ sūtrayāmāsuḥ iti śārīrakamīmāṃsādyādhikaraṇatṛtīyavarṇakabhāṣyāda arthato'vagamyate| etādṛśaviśeṣaṇalambhakaśrutayastu 'yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityam' iti nyāyavatī "tadyathehakarmacito lokaḥkṣīyate evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥkṣīyate", "yo vai bhūmā tadamṛtam, ato'nyadārtam", "na jāyate mriyate vā vipaścit " ityādiśrutiḥ ātmanaḥ nityatvam, anātmanaḥ anityatvaṃ ca bodhayatīti vivekalambhikā | "parīkṣya lokān karmacitān brāhmaṇo nirvedamāyānnāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena", "na vā are patyuḥ kāmāya ityārabhya, "ātmanastu kāmāya sarvapriyaṃ bhavati" ityantā śrutiḥ anātmamātre vairāgyapratipādikā | "śānto dānta uparatastitikṣuḥ samāhitaḥśraddhāvitto bhūtvā''tmanyevātmānaṃ paśyet " iti śrutiḥ śamādiṣaṭkaṃ bodhayati| "na sa punarāvartate" iti śrutiḥ mokṣasya nityatvaṃ vadantī tatrecchāmādadhāti| upaniṣadāmarthavādatvaṃ vadatāṃ karmamīmāṃsakānāṃ mate etāsāṃ svārthe tātparyaṃ nāstītyeva jñānasambhavāt "brahmajijñāsitavyaṃ", tatra ca etādṛśaviśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭo'dhikārīti jñānasya durlabhatvāt manīṣibhiḥ kathitānītyuktam | tathā ca pramāṇāntarānadhigatakālatrayābādhyaparamapuruṣārthasvarūpa brahmapratipādakatvādupaniṣadāṃ tāttvikaprāmāṇyasyātraiva sambhavāt tattadvākyasamarpitavivekādiviśiṣṭasyaiva "so'nveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ" ityādivākyavihitajijñāsāyogyateti sarvaṃ caturasram ||18|| tatra vivekino viraktasyetyādinā kathitaṃ vivekādikaṃ kramato nirdiśati ādāvityādinā -- ādau nityānityavastuvivekaḥ parigaṇyate | ihāmutraphalabhogavirāgastadanantaram ||19|| śamādiṣaṭkasaṃpattiḥ mumukṣutvamiti sphuṭam | anvayaḥ ādau nityānityavastuvivekaḥtadanantaraṃ ihāmutraphalabhogavirāgaḥśamādiṣaṭkasampattiḥmumukṣutvaṃ iti sphuṭam parigaṇyate ||19|| bhāṣyam -- vivekādīnāṃ madhye pūrvapūrvasya uttarottarahetutvāt kramaḥ samāśritaḥ| idaṃ nityaṃ idamanityamiti janānaḥ kila anityādvirajyeta | ataḥ nityānityavastuvivekābhāve vairāgyaṃ dussampādam iti vivekasya vairāgyahetutvam | vairāgyavata eva puruṣasya antarbahirindriyanirodharūpaśāntidāntī | tatrāpi niruddhāntaḥkaraṇasyaiva bahirindriyanirodharūpadamaḥ manassambandhābhāve itareṣāmindriyāṇāmakiñcitkaratvāt | tarhi śame sati damasya svatassiddhatvāt kimiti tasya sādhanakoṭipraviṣṭatvamiti cet , "indriyāṇi pramāthīni haranti prasabhaṃ manaḥ"| iti gītoktarītyā bāhyendriyanirodhābhāve śamasya dṛḍhatvābhāvāt| jitendriyasyaiva uparamaśabditasaṃnyāsaḥ, tasyaiva śītoṣṇādidvandvasahiṣṇutvarūpā titikṣā, tasyaiva bāhyavikṣepābhāvāt brahmaṇyaidamparyeṇāvasthānalakṣaṇaṃ samādhānam, etāddaśaguṇaviśiṣṭasyaiva brahmaikamasti jaganmithye ityupadiśyamānaguruvedāntavākya viśvāsarūpaśraddhā iti | śamādiṣaṭkamadhye'pi pūrvāparībhāve kāraṇaṃ suvacam| etādṛśaḥ kila puruṣadhaureyaḥ mokṣādanyanna kāmayate, tatra vilambaṃ ca na sahata iti tīvramumukṣāvān bhavitumarhati ityabhiprāyeṇa ādau nityānityetyādyāha| tadanantaraṃ ihāmutraphalabhogavirāga iti ca | tena vivekānantaryasya vairāgye kathanena 'taduditaḥ sa hi yo yadanantaraḥ' iti nyānena vivekakāryatvaṃ vairāgye uktaprāyam | tadanantaramiti uttaratrāpyanuṣajyate vairāgyānantaraṃ śamādisaṃpattiḥ, tadanantaraṃ mumukṣutvamiti ||19|| uktasādhanāni vivṛṇti -- brahmetyādinā | brahma satyaṃ jaganmithyetyevaṃ rūpo viniścayaḥ ||20|| soyaṃ nityānityavastuvivekaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ ||201/2|| anvayaḥ brahma satyaṃ jagat mithyā iti evaṃ rūpaḥ viniścayaḥ saḥ ayaṃ nityānityavastuvivekaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ|| 20|| bhāṣyam -- brahma nityaṃ jagadanityamiti niścayasatve'pi dṛḍhaṃ vairāgyaṃ na sambhavati, anityasukhasyāpi prāyaḥ kāmyamānatvāt | jaganmithyetyukte mithyābhūtārthaḥ kenāpi na kāmyate | na hi svāpnikaṃ rājyaṃ kāmayante rājyakāmayitāraḥ| ataḥ vairāgyasya niyatamutpattaye brahma nityaṃ jagadanityamityanuktvā brahma satyaṃ jaganmithyetyāha |viniścaya iti viśeṣṇa niścaya ityarthakena niścaye'prāmāṇyajñānānāskanditatvamuktaṃ bhavati | soyamiti, saḥ vivekina ityatra vivekiviśeṣaṇatvenoktaḥ, ayam ādau nityānityavastuviveka ityuktaḥ ityarthaḥ | asyaiva ऎhikāmuṣmikaphalabhogavirāgahetutvaṃ niyatamiti samudāhṛta ityatra samityupasargeṇa dyotitam ||201/2 || vivekaṃ nirūpya vairāgyaṃ nirūpayati tadvairājyamiti -- tadvairāgyaṃ jugupsā yā darśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ ||21|| dehādibrahmaparyante hyanitye bhogyavastuni ||211/2|| anvayaḥ darśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ dehādibrahmaparyante hi anitye bhogavastuni yā jigupsā(jihāsā) tadvairāgyaṃ || 21|| bhāṣyam -- ऎhikadehādibhogyavastunaḥ darśanena, āmuṣmikadivyadehādi bhogyavastunaḥ śravaṇena, ādipadena dṛṣṭajātīyasya śrutajātīyasya anumānena | anubhūyamānaśarīraprabhṛtibrāhmamānena śatavarṣajīvicaturdaśabhuvanādhipatyāvacchedakahiraṇyagarbhaśarīraparyantaṃ sarvasmin bhogyastuni anitye mithyābhūte yā jugupsā, kadāpīdṛśapadārthasambandho mābhūditi, kākaviṣṭhāyāmivāsahyabuddhiḥ tadvairāgyam | 'śaityaṃ hi yatsā prakṛtirjalasya' itivada vidyeyaprādhānyāt napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ taditi| svadehāśucigandhena na virajyeta yaḥ pumān | vairāgyakāraṇaṃ tasya kimanyadupadiśyatām satataṃ pravāhyamānaiḥ vṛṣabhaiḥaśvaiḥ kharairgajaiḥ mahiṣaiḥ | hā kaṣṭaṃ kṣutkṣāmaiḥ śrāntairno śakyate vaktum || "tadyatheha karmacito lokaḥ kṣīyate evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate", "bhūmnonyadārtam", " kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti", "ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartinorjuna" sūtasaṃhitāyāṃ yajñavaibhavakhaṇḍe saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ, sarvavedāntasiddhāntasārasaṅgrahasthāḥ 'kukṣau svamāturmalamūtramadhye 'ityādinā puṇyakṣaye puṇyakṛto nabhasthaiḥ nipātyamānān śithilīkṛtāṅgan | nakṣatrarūpeṇa divaścayutāṃstān vicārya ko vā viratiṃ na yāti || yatrāsti loke gatitāratamyaṃ ityantāśca ślokāḥ vairāgyaviṣaye'nusaṃdheyāḥ | mānuṣadehādeḥ rogādyupaplutatvaṃ, paśvādīnāmatyantapāratantryaṃ mūkatvādi, devānāṃ rākṣasādipīḍitatvaṃ, śabdādīnāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ bahuvidhānarthapradatvaṃ kuraṅgādidṛṣṭāntaiḥ anusandadhānasya sarvatrānātmasu jugupsā sulabheti bhāvaḥ| etacca 'śabdādibhiḥ pañcabhireve' ityādinā svayamuttaratra spaṣṭayiṣyate | yadyapi "apāma somamamṛtā abhūma" "akṣayyaṃ ha vai cāturmāsyayājinassukṛtaṃ bhavati " iti śrutyavalokanena karmaphalasyāpi nityatvaṃ pratīyate| athāpi 'yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityam' iti nyāyasahakṛtatadyatheha karmacita ityādiśrutyanusāreṇa amṛtākṣayyapadayoḥ saṅkucitārthakatvasyāvaśyaṃ vaktavyatvāt na doṣaḥ | uktaṃ hi -- "ābhūtasampalvaṃ sthānamamṛtatvaṃ hi bhāṣyate"| iti ||211/2|| śamasvarūpaṃ bravīti virajyeti -- virajya viṣayavrātāt doṣadṛṣṭyā muhurmuhuḥ ||22|| svalakṣye niyatāvasthā manasaḥ śama ucyate ||221/2|| anvayaḥ doṣadṛṣṭyā viṣayavrātāt muhurmuhuḥ virajya svalakṣye manasaḥ niyatāvasthā (saḥ) śama ucyate|| 22|| bhāṣyam -- ādyantavatvabahuvittavyayāyāsasādhyatva -- pariṇativirasatvādidoṣān punaḥpunaḥ viṣayeṣu paśyataḥ puruṣasya tatra vairāgyaṃ niyatamiti viṣayadoṣadarśanaṃ vairāgyaheturiti |tasmiṃśca vairāgye sati manassvalakṣye suguṇe nirguṇe vā niyatamavatiṣṭhamānaṃ niścalaṃ nirvikāraṃ bhavatīti manoniyatāvasthārūpaśamasya vairāgyajanyatvamāha virajyeti | tatra lyapā uttarakālikatvasya bodhanāt vairāgyajanyatvaṃ bodhitaṃ bhavati || 221/2 || damaṃ nirūpayati viṣayebhya iti -- viṣayebhyaḥ parāvartya sthāpanaṃ svasvagolake ||23|| ubhayeṣāmindrayāṇāṃ sa damaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||23 1/2 || anvayaḥ viṣayebhyaḥ ubhayeṣāṃ indriyāṇāṃ parāvartya svasvagolake sthāpanaṃ saḥ damaḥ parikīrtitaḥ|| 23|| bhāṣyam -- manasaḥ viṣayavicārasāmarthyasattvātsvata eva virajyetyuktam bāhyendriyāṇāṃ śrotrādīnāṃ jñānakaraṇānāṃ, vāgādīnāṃ karmakaraṇānāṃ ca svatastatra sāmarthyābhāvāt pragrahasthānīyena manasā aśvasthānīyānāṃ bahindriyāṇāṃ śabdādirūpaviṣamamārgebhyaḥ parāvartya parāṅmukhīkṛtya svasvagolake karṇaśaṣkulīvadanādideśeṣu sthāpanaṃ uparatavyāprāratā sampādanaṃ yat sa damaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | mana ādīnāṃ pragrahādirūpatvaṃ kaṭhopaniṣadyuktam -- ātmānaṃ rathinaṃ viddhi śarīraṃ rathameva tu | buddhiṃ tu sārathiṃ viddhi manaḥ pragrahameva ca| idriyāṇi hayānāhurviṣayāṃsteṣu gocarān | iti mārgānityarthaḥ||23 1/2|| damarūpabahirindriyanigrahasādhyāmuparatimāha bāhyeti -- bāhyānālambanaṃ vṛttereṣoparatiruttamā || 24 || anvayaḥ (antaḥkaraṇa)vṛtteḥbāhyānālambanaṃ eṣā uttama uparatiḥ|| 24|| bhāṣyam -- taṭākodakasya taṭākacchidradvārā nirgatya yathā kṣtrādyātmanā pariṇāmaḥ, evamantasthasya manasaḥ śrotrādicchidradvārā bahirāgatya śabdādiviṣayākāreṇa pariṇāmarūpā vṛttirjāyate | nigṛhīteṣu ca bahirindriyeṣu antasthaṃ manaḥ na bāhyākāreṇa pariṇamata iti bhāvaḥ||24|| yadā bāhyaṃ nālambate cittaṃ tadā śītṣṇādidvandvasya apratīyamānatvāt karmakālādivaśāt tatprasaktāvapi tatsahanarūpā titikṣā siddhyatītyāha sahanamiti -- sahanaṃ sarva duḥkhānāṃ apratīkārapūrvakam | cintāvilāparahitaṃ sā titikṣā nigadyate ||25|| anvayaḥ sarvaduḥkhānām sahanaṃ apratīkārapūrvakaṃ cintāvilāparahitaṃ sā titikṣā nigadyate|| 25|| bhāṣyam -- kambalavyajanādibhiḥ śaityoṣṇyādiduḥkhapratīkāraḥ lokasiddhaḥ | tādṛśasāmagryabhāve kimasmābhirdīnaiḥ karaṇīyamiti cintā, pralāpaśca| vicārasādhanatitikṣāyāstathātvaṃ vyāvartayati apratīkārapūrvakaṃ cintāvilāparahitaṃ yatsahanaṃ sā titikṣeti | duḥkhānāṃ duḥkhahetuśītoṣṇādīnāmityarthaḥ| cintāvilāpādisahitasya manasaḥ vicārasya dūrāpāstatvāditi bhāvaḥ ||25|| idānīṃ vastūpalabdhyasādhāraṇakāraṇaṃ śraddhāṃ nirūpayati śāstrasyeti -- śāstrasya guruvākyasya satyabudhyāvadhāraṇā | sā śraddhā kathitā sadbhiryayā vastūpalabhyate ||26|| anvayaḥ śāstrasya guruvākyasya (ca) satyabuddhyavadhāraṇā sā sadbhiḥśraddhā (iti) kathitā yayā vastu upalabhyate|| 26|| bhāṣyam -- loke'pi āptavākye viśvāsābhāve naiva tadanusāreṇa pravartate puruṣaḥ vicārādau | kimutātīndriye śāstrārthe, ataḥ sā paramakāraṇam | uktaṃ hi gītāyāṃ aśraddhadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa | aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani || iti | yastāvat śānto dānta uparatastitikṣuśca sa eva brahmaikameva satyaṃ tadeva tvaṃ anyatsarvaṃ mithyā iti guruṇā vedāntaiśca bodhyamānaṃ vastu viśvasiti idamevameveti | nānyastādṛśasādhanahīnaḥ iti śraddhā tadanantaraṃ parigaṇitā guruvedāntavākyaviṣayiṇī | śāstraṃ tattvamasyādiśāstraṃ guruvākyaṃ tadanusāri nāsitvaṃ saṃsārī kintu nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāvaṃ paraṃ brahmaiva anyatsarvaṃ mithyā ityādi vākyaṃ tasya satyam abādhitārthabodhakam iti budhyā, avadhāraṇā dṛḍhaviśvāsaḥ , yayā vastūpalabhyate sā śradhā iti sadbhiḥ kathitetyanvayaḥ ||26|| etādṛśaśraddhāvataeva samādhānaṃ samyaksiddhyatīti tadanantaraṃ samādhānaṃ nirūpayati samyagiti -- samyagāsthāpanaṃ buddheḥ śuddhe brahmaṇi sarvadā | tatsamādhānamityuktaṃ na tu cittasya lālanam ||27|| anvayaḥ śuddhe brahmaṇi sarvadā samyagā buddheḥ sthāpanaṃ tat samādhānaṃ (iti)uktam tu na cittasya lālanam|| 27|| bhāṣyam -- yadyapi svalakṣye niyatāvasthārūpaśamāpekṣayā bhedo na lakṣyati īdṛśe samādhāne , tathāpi 'muhurmuhuḥ doṣadṛṣṭyā viṣayebhyo virajya svalakṣye niyatāvasthā 'ityanena yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram | tatastato niyamyaitat ātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet || iti gītoktarītyā śamāvasthāyāṃ prayatnaviśeṣo'pekṣyate saṃkalpavikalpātmakasya manasaḥ sthirīkaraṇe | ata evātra adhyavasāyātmikāyāḥ buddheḥ śuddhe brhmaṇi samyagāsthāpanaṃ sarvadā ityanena saṃkalpavikalpavinirmuktatvamantaḥkaraṇasya prakṛte kathitaṃ bhavati | ata eva manaḥśabdaṃ vihāya nirṇayātmakavṛttimadbuddhiśabdaḥ prāyoji| tatrāpi śuddhe brahmaṇīti nirguṇaṃ kathyate sarvopādhivinirmuktam | śamanirūpaṇāvasare svalakṣye niyatāvasthetyanena saguṇe niyatāvasthāne'pi śāntatvaṃ manaso vaktuṃ śakyam | śama iti sādhanaṃ kathyate , samādhānaṃ tasya phalaṃ tasyaiva paripāka iti yāvat | loke bālakā viśeṣato rudanti cet tadiṣṭaṃ datvā samādadhate janāḥ, tadvat manaso yatheṣṭaṃ viṣayamārgasañcaraṇaṃ na samādhānamityāha na tu cittasya lālanamiti | yadvā -- śubhāśubhābhyāṃ mārgābhyāṃ vahantī vāsanāsarit | pauruṣeṇa prayatnena yojanīyā śubhe pathi ||1|| aśubheṣu samāviṣṭaṃ śubheṣvevāvatārayet | svamanaḥpuruṣārthena balena balināṃ vara ||2|| aśubhāccālitaṃ yāti śubhaṃ tasmādapītarat | jantościttaṃ tu śiśuvat tasmāttaccālayed balāt ||3|| samatāsāntvanenāśu na drāgiti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | pauruṣeṇa prayatnena lālayeccittabālakam ||4|| iti vāsiṣṭharītyā cālanaṃ lālanaṃ vā śamādisādhanatvena pūrvamapekṣyate | na tu phalībhūtasamādhānāvasthāyāṃ , tadābhyāsaṃ vināpi śamādisampādanakāle kṛtaprayatnenaiva kṣīṇabāhyavāsanasya manasaḥ saguṇātpracyāvanamātrasya nirguṇe sthāpayitumapekṣitatvāt iti ||27|| etādṛśasādhanagaṇamaṇḍitasyaiva mumukṣutvaṃ sanbhavati nānyasyeti idānīṃ mumukṣutvamāha ahaṅkārādīti -- ahaṅkārādidehāntān bandhānajñā~kalpitān | svasvarūpāvabodhena moktumicchā mumukṣutā ||28|| anvayaḥ svasvarūpāvabodhena ahaṃkārādidehāntān bandhān ajñānakalpitān moktuṃ icchā (sā) mumukṣutā|| 28|| bhāṣyam -- antaḥkaraṇameteṣu cakṣurādiṣu varṣmaṇi | ahamityabhimānena tiṣṭhatyābhāsatejasā || ahaṅkāraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ ityuktyā citpratiphalanopetamantaḥkaraṇam ahaṅkāraḥ | yadvā bhoktā jīvo'haṅkāraḥ ānandamayakośanāmā, svātmanirūpaṇe -- suptigataissukhaleśaiḥ abhimanute sukhībhavāmīti | ānandakośanāmā so'ṅhaṃkāraḥ kathaṃ bhavedātmā iyuktatvāt | tasyāpyajñānakalpitatvaṃ manorūpopādhivaśādvikāratvaṃ ca gauṇaṃ vaktuṃ śakyam | tathā ca ānandakośaprabhṛtivijñānamayamanomayaprāṇamayānnamayāntān bandhān svarūpasākṣātkārātprāgātmatvena manyamānān svasvarūpāvabodhena moktuṃ punastatra yathā'hantā na syāt tathā vyaktuṃ bādhitumityarthaḥ | yā icchā sā mumukṣutā | svasvarūpāvabodhe hi "yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūt tatkena kaṃ paśyet " iti śrutyā svavyatiriktasya kasyāpi bhānābhāvena kośapañcakātmakabandhanivṛttiratyantamiti bhāvaḥ ||28|| iyaṃ tāvat mumukṣutā trividhā -- mandā madhyamā pravṛddhā ceti | mokṣasya nityasukharūpatve'pi sāṃsārikavāsanāvāsitātaḥkaraṇānāṃ mokṣecchaiva durlabhā | adhyātmaśāstraśravaṇakāle jātā sā na kāryamādadhāti| yadā puruṣaḥ śravaṇānantarajātavivekena viṣayeṣu sāṃsārikeṣu doṣān darśaṃ darśaṃ tatra vairāgyaṃ labdhvā vidhivatsaṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi, vicārārthaṃ gurūpasadanādau pravartate tadā adhyātmaśāstraśravaṇakāle jātā tātkālikyeva mumukṣutā mandeti nāmārhaiva madhyamatvaṃ prāpnoti | yathā yathā tīvraṃ vairāgyaṃ manaścopaśāntaṃ samādhitsati guruścasminprasīdati kṣipramayaṃ taratu bhavābdhrimiti tadā puruṣaḥ nityasukharūmokṣādanyanna kāmayate tatra vilambaṃ ca na sahata iti pravṛddhamumukṣuḥ mukhyādhikārī bhūtvā kṣipraṃ labhate phlamityāha mandeti -- mandamadhyamarūpā'pi vairāgyeṇa śamādinā | prasādena guroḥseyaṃ pravṛddhā sūyate phalam ||29|| anvayaḥ mandamadhyamarūpāpi sūyate phalam(iti)sā iyaṃ pravṛddhā guroḥ prasādena vairāgyeṇa śamādina || 29|| bhāṣyam -- itthaṃ ca mumukṣāyā mokṣecchārūpatve'pi yadā sā pravṛddhā tadaiva phalaṃ prasūta ityanena tatpravṛddhayarthaṃ viṣayavairāgyaśamādiṣaṭkaguruprasādalābhārthaṃ prayatnaḥ kartavyaḥ puruṣeṇtyuktaṃ bhavati ||29|| sādhanacatuṣṭayamadhye dvitīyaturīyasattve sarvaṃ tatrāsti nānyathetyāha | vairāgyamiti -- vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ tīvraṃ yasya tu vidyate | tasminnevārthavantaḥ syuḥ phalavantaḥ śamādayaḥ ||30|| anvayaḥ śamādayaḥ arthavantaḥ syuḥ phalavantaḥtasmin eva yasya tu tīrvaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ (asti)|| 30|| bhāṣyam -- arthavantaśśamādaya ityatra śamādaya ityasya śamādiśabdā ityarthaḥ |tasminpuruṣe śamādayassantīti vyavahārassārthaka iti bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ śānto dāntaḥ ityādiśabdabhāk tīvravairāgyavān tīvramumukṣutāvāṃścetyarthaḥ tīvramumukṣutvasyaiva śamādiphalatvāt | yadi tīvramumukṣutvaṃ tadā sādhanaṃ vinā phalālābhātkāryātkāraṇamanumīyata iti śamādimattvaṃ tasya suvacam | evaṃ śamādisādhanaṃ tīvravairāgyaṃ yadā tasmin jñāyate , sādhane sati phalāvaśyambhāvāt śamādimatvaṃ tasminnavarjanīyam | itthaṃ ca śamādisādhane sati tīvravairāgyaśamādiphale ca tīvramumukṣutve svasādhanaphalamadhyavarti svayaṃ nirapavādamiti bhāvaḥ | tīvravairāgye śamādiśbdāḥ arthavantaḥ, tīvramumukṣutve śamādayaḥ phalavantaḥ iti vibhāgaḥ | śamādīnāmitarāntaḥkaraṇaniṣṭhānāṃ durjñānatvāt kāraṇakāryābhyāmavagantavyamuktam | svayamapi puruṣeṇa śāntyādikaṃ samapādīti kathaṃ jñeyamityuktau puṣkalakāraṇe tīvravairāgye viśiṣṭaphale tīvramumukṣutve ca sati tatheti svasmin parasmiṃśca kāraṇakārye jñāpake iti bhāvaḥ| kākasya viṣṭhāvadasahyabuddhirbhogyeṣu sā tīvraviraktiriṣyate | viraktitīvratvanidhānamāhuḥ bhogyeṣu doṣekṣaṇameva santaḥ || iti vairāgye tīvratvaṃ tatsādhanaṃ ca kathitaṃ sarvavedāntasiddhāntasārasaṅgrahe | mumukṣutve tīvratvaṃ pravṛddhatvameva | tattu prāgabhihitam ||30|| etayormandatā yatra viraktatvamumukṣayoḥ | marau salilavattatra śamāderbhānamātratā ||31|| anvayaḥ yatra viraktatvamumukṣayoḥ etayoḥ mandatā (asti) tatra marau salīlavat śamādeḥ bhānamātratā|| 31|| bhāṣyam -- yatra yasminpuruṣe etayoḥ viraktatvamumukṣayoḥ mandatā tātkālikatvaṃ marau salilavat, nidāghasamaye marubhūmau caṇḍakiraṇasamparke dūrasthasya tatra jalamastīti bhrāntirbhavati na jalalābhaḥ tatra naiva pipāsānivṛttiḥ, pratyuta śrāntasya tatra jaladhiyā jalārthaṃ gamanena śramādhikyameva, tadvattīvravairāgyamumukṣatvayorabhāve marusalilavat śamādestatra bhānamātratā na śamādiphalaṃ tasya , nāpītaraiḥ śānta ityādiśabdairvyavahiyate ca iti bhāvaḥ ||31|| evaṃ sarveṣāṃ vedāntānāmadvitīyabrahmaṇi pratyagabhinne nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāve tātparyanirṇayānukūlavyāpararūpaśravaṇātmakabrahmavicārādhikāriṇ viśeṣaṇāni vivekādīni nirūpya ātmasākṣātkārasākṣātsādhanaṃ bhaktiṃ pūrvoktavicārasādhyāmāha -- mokṣeti | mokṣakāraṇasāmagryāṃ bhaktireva garīyasī | svasvarūpānusandhānaṃ bhaktirityabhidhīyate ||32|| anvayaḥ (eteṣāṃ) mokṣakāraṇasāmagryāṃ bhaktiḥeva garīyasī (tasmāt) svasvarūpānusandhānaṃ (eva) bhaktiḥ iti abhidhīyate|| 32|| bhāṣyam -- svasvarūpānusandhānamiti nididhyāsanamucyate | tasyaiva sākṣātkāraṃ prati sākṣātsādhanatvāt | śrutyācāryopadeśena ' sa ātmā tattvamasi' iti śrutaḥyo'rthaḥ tava svarūpaṃ brahma tadeva tvamiti, tadanusandhānaṃ tadbhāvanādhārā vijātīyapratyayātiraskṛtasajātīya pratyayapravāharūpā sākṣātkāre asādhāraṇaṃ kāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ| śamadīnāṃ vicāradvārakanididhyāsanadvārākāraṇatvaṃ jñāne, asya tu sākṣāditi bhāvaḥ| ata eva mokṣasya kāraṇaṃ abhivyañjakaṃ yajjñānaṃ tatsāmagryāṃ tatsādhanasamudāyamadhye bhaktireva garīyasī sākṣātkāraṇatvādityuktam | sā ca sāmagrī vivekādinidhyāsanāntā ||32|| apareṣāṃ matamāha | svātmatattvānusandhānaṃ bhaktirityapare jaguḥ ||321/2 || anvayaḥ bhaktiḥ svātmatattvānusandhānaṃ iti apare jaguḥ || 321/2|| bhāṣyam -- svātmanaḥ svasya jīvasya tatvānusandhānam | tasya bhāvastattvam tatpadavācyārthatvam paramātmattvamityarthaḥ| tasyānusandhānaṃ, vāstavikabhedasattve'pi abhedenopāsanam ahaṅgrahopāsanamiti yāvat | tat bhaktiriti apare jaguḥ iti bhedabuddhipurassarāyāḥ bhrāntirūpāyā asyāḥ mukhyabhaktitvaṃ nāstīti sūcitam ||321/2|| pūrvoktasādhanasampannasya kṛtyamāha ukteti -- uktasādhanasampannaḥ tatvajijñāsurātmanaḥ upasīded guruṃ prājñaṃ yasmād bandhavimokṣaṇam||331/2|| anvayaḥ (yaḥ)uktasādhanasaṃpannaḥ ātmanaḥ tattvajijñāsuḥ yasmāt bandhavimokṣaṇam guruṃ prājñāṃ upasīdet || 33|| bhāṣyam -- uktasādhanasampannaḥ uktāni vicārasādhanatvena kathitāni yāni vivekādīni sādhanāni taiḥ sampannaḥ yuktaḥ , pumāniti śeṣaḥ | ātmanaḥ svasya tattvaṃ jñātumicchuḥ svayāthātmyajñānakāmaḥ upasīdet śaraṇaṃ gacchet, kam ? gurumupadeśakam | kīdṛśam? prājñaṃ ,prakṛṣṭā niratiśayā jñā avagatiḥ prajñā brahmasākṣātkāraḥ | brahmatmanoḥ śodhitayorekabhāvāvagāhinī | nirvikalpā ca cinmātrā vṛttiḥ prajñeti kathyate iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | sāsyāstīti prajñaḥ sa eva prājñaḥ , taṃ brahmaniṣṭhamityarthaḥ | tena svasya phalamāha || yasmādyādṛśaguroḥ sakāśāt , bandhavimokṣaṇaṃ bandhasya ajñānakalpitasya ahaṅkārādidehāntasya vimokṣaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇaparityāgaḥ iti | tādṛśagurūpasadane tadupadeśajanyasvayāthātmyajñānena bandhanivṛttirūpamokṣaḥ sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ ||331/2|| tādṛśaṃ guruṃ lakṣayati, śrotriya ityādinā -- śrotriyo'vṛjino'kāmahato yo brahmaviduttamaḥ | brahmaṇyuparataḥ śānto nirindhana ivānalaḥ ||341/2 || anvayaḥ yaḥ śrotriyaḥ avṛjinaḥ akāmahataḥ brahmavittamaḥ brahmaṇi uparataḥ śāntaḥ nirindhanaḥ iva analaḥ||34|| bhāṣyam -- 'śrotriyaśchando'dhīte' iti pāṇininā'nuśiṣṭatvāt adhītopaniṣatka ityarthaḥ |upaniṣadamadhītya kṛtatadarthavicārasyaiva sākṣātkārahetutvāt | avṛjinaḥ niṣpāpa ityarthaḥ | nāvirato duścaritāt nāśānto nāsamāhitaḥ | nāśāntamānaso vāpi prajñānenainamāpnuyāt || iti śruteḥ | tatra kāraṇamāha akāmahata iti | kāmena viṣayāśayā hataḥ kāmahataḥ abhāsitasvasvarūpa ityarthaḥ | na kāmahataḥ akāmahataḥ yastāvatsvarūpaṃ ānandaṃ na jānāti sa eva bahirānando'stīti taṃ prāptuṃ kadācitpāpamapi kuryāt | asya tāvat brahmavittamasya sākṣātkriyamāṇasvarūpānandatvāt viṣayā vinivartante nirāhārasya dehinaḥ | rasavarjaṃ raso'psya paraṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate iti gītoktarītyā nivṛttarāgatvarūpākāmahatatvaṃ sidhyatyeveti niṣpāpatvaṃ tasmin | kāmasyaiva pāpahetutvāt | taduktam gītāsu -- atha kena prayukto'yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ | anichannapi vārṣṇeya balādiva niyojitaḥ || ityarjunena pṛṣṭo bhagavānāha kāma eṣakrodha eṣa rajoguṇasamudbhavaḥ | mahāśano mahāpāpmā viddhayenamiha vairiṇam ityādi | brahmaṇyuparataḥ brahmaṇi vilīnamaskaḥ ata eva nirindhana anala iva śāntaḥ , yathā indhanābhāve agniḥ śāntaḥ jvālāśūnyaḥ bhāti tathā anālambita bāhyavṛttitvāt śāntaḥ nirguṇe brahmaṇi pariniṣṭhitacittatvāt śāntaḥ nirvikāra ityarthaḥ | atra śrtriyatvādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ vyāvartakatvaṃ nāsti, brahmavittame aśrotriyatvasya pāpasya kāmahatatvasya ca asambhāvitatvāt , kantu vastusattayā teṣāṃ tādṛśagurujñāpakatvaṃ ,sambhavatīti svarūpalakṣaṇatmeva mantavyam ||34 1/2|| ahetukadayāsindhurbandhurānamatāṃ satām ||35|| anvayaḥ (yaḥ)ahetukadayāsindhuḥsatāmaṃ ānamatāṃ bandhuḥ ||35|| bhāṣyam -- na vidyate heturyasyāḥ sā ahetukī tādṛśī yā dayā paraduḥkhaprahāṇecchā tasyāḥ siṃdhuḥ āśraya ityarthaḥ | itarasya dayālorapi dayā anyatra duḥkhadarśanena svasyāpi jātaduḥkhatvāt | tannirāsārthamahetuketi | asya tu jñānamahimnā svato vā parato vā duḥkhaprasakteḥ kevalaṃ janāstarantu saṃsāravārdhiṃmiti icchā paraṃ vyutthānakāle iti bhāvaḥ | bandhuḥ duḥkhahāraka ityarthaḥ | keṣām ? ānamatāṃ satāṃ prahvībhavatāṃ satpuruṣāṇāmityanena śiṣyasya lakṣaṇaṃ parijñāyaiva te upadiśantīti sūcitam | śrūyate kila tatra nāsūyakāyānṛjave śaṭhāya, idamaśiṣyāya no deyam ityādi | smaryate ca gītāyām idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana | nācāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati || idamapusadanaṃ samīpagamanaṃ -- tamārādhya guruṃ bhaktyā prahvaḥ praśrayasevanaiḥ | prasannaṃ tamanuprāpya pṛcched jñātavyamātmanaḥ ||36|| anvayaḥ tamaṃ guruṃ bhaktyā ārādhya prahvapraśrayasevanaiḥ prasannaṃ tamaṃ anuprāpya ātmanaḥ jñātavyaṃ pṛcchet || 36|| bhāṣyam -- bhaktiḥ pūjyeṣvanurāgaḥ mānasadharmaḥ , tayā prahvaḥ tadvyaṃñjakākāraviśiṣṭaḥ namrakāyaḥ baddhāñjalipuṭaḥ, praśrayasevanaiḥ praśrayaśca sevanāni ca praśrayasevanāni tairityarthaḥ | tatra praśrayaḥ vinītavāktvaṃ sevanāni sāṣṭāṅganamaskāratatpādasaṃvahanataduktakaraṇādīni taistamārādhya saṃsevya ,ṛjvyā tayā sevayā prasanna svābhimukhaṃ taṃ anuprāpya yathāsamayanirdeśaṃ tatsannidhau yathāvidhi sthitvā ātmanaḥ jñātavyaṃ yajjijñāsitaṃ ātmayāthātmyaviṣaye tatpṛcchet | bhaktyā prahvaḥ praśrayasevanairārādhya ityanena ārādhayituḥ manasi vacasi kāye ca śuddhatvarūpatrikaraṇaśuddhiruktā ||36|| bhaktipurassaravācikārādhanaprakāraṃ dayayā darśayati bhagavān jijñāsubhyaḥ svāminnamaste ityādinā tathā vadantamityantam -- svāminnamaste natalokabandho kāruṇyasindho patitaṃ bhavābdhau | māmuddharātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā'tikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā ||37|| anvayaḥ (he) svāmin namaste natalokabandho kāruṇyasindho bhavābdhau patitaṃ māṃ uddharā (tava) ātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā|| 37|| bhāṣyam -- natalokabandho natānāṃ kṛtanatīnāṃ lokānāṃ janānāṃ bandhuḥ duḥkhamocakaḥ tasya sambuddhau natalokabandho , svāmin prabho, te tubhyaṃ namaḥ, prahvībhāvaḥ astviti śeṣaḥ | yatastvaṃ natalokaduḥkhamocakaḥ atastvāṃ duḥkhamuktyai namāmīti bhāvaḥ| tatra hetumāha kāruṇyasindho iti sambodhanena | vivṛtametat ahetukadayāsindhurityatra | svakīyaṃ duḥkhaṃ nivedayati bhavābdhau patitaṃ , janmarārogamaraṇānarthasaṅkule saṃsārasamudre patitamityarthaḥ| idānīṃ tannivṛttiṃ prārthayate māmuddhareti | janmādibandhanirmuktaṃ kurvityarthaḥ | tatra sādhanaṃ yācate ātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyeti | svakīyalocanaprāntenetyarthaḥ |brahmasākṣātkāranirdhūtasakalamalasya bhavataḥ pavitrakaṭākṣapāte sakalapāpanirmukto'haṃ saṃsārasāgaraṃ tarāmīti bhāvaḥ| uktaṃ hi yasyānubhavaparyantā buddhiḥsatve pravartate | taddṛṣṭigocarāssarve mucyante sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || iti | etena śiṣyeṇa gurossākṣātpuraḥ na stheyamiti vinayaprakāro darśito bhavati | kiñca sampūrṇāvalokanaṃ kaṭākṣapāta eva | atastatkāmaye ityapi bhāvaḥ | nityaśuddhabrahmānandamagnasya manasaḥ cakṣuḥprāntadvārā pūrṇatayā mayi pāte sarvathā'pi pūtaḥ duḥkhavimukto bhaveyamahamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā ātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā svakīyasānugrahavīkṣaṇenetyarthaḥ | ṛjvyā svabhāvasaralayā, tadviśeṣaṇena yathā loke agādhajalapatitaḥ ṛjvīṃ rajjuṃ yaṣṭiṃ vā avalambya uddhṛto bhavati tathā'ha bhavatkaṭākṣaṃ dīrdhadīrdhamavalambya saṃsārābdheruddhṛto bhavāmīti bhāvaḥ vyañjitaḥ| sūryamaṇḍalādvā dīpādvā kiraṇāḥ puñjībhūya rajjuvadyathā niṣkrāmanti tathā cakṣuṣo'pi tejastvāt niṣkrāntā raśmayaḥ etasmin saṅkrāntāḥ brahmaniṣṭhamanassaṃyuktatvādenamuddharantīti bhāvaḥ | atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā atyantaṃ kāruṇyaṃ atikāruṇyaṃ tadeva sudhā, sakalatāpahārakatvāt sudheti rūpyate| sudhā nāmāmṛtaṃ, tasyāḥ abhito vṛṣṭiḥ yasyāṃ dṛṣṭyāṃ sā atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭiḥ tayā atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā | amṛtābhivarṣaṇena puruṣaḥ jarāmaraṇādivarjito bhavatīti prasiddham | yuddhe mṛtā vānarā indrakāritāmṛtavarṣaṇena ujjīvitā iti rāmāyaṇe prasiddham | tādṛśāmṛtasyaiva tathātve brahmaniṣṭhānukampāmṛtavarṣaṇadṛṣṭiḥ asaṅkucitajarāmaraṇādivarjitatvaṃ dāsyatīti bhāvaḥ ||37|| svoddharaṇe vilambamasahiṣṇuḥ svakīyatīvramumukṣutvaṃ prakaṭīkaroti durvāreti -- durvārasaṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ dodhūyamānaṃ duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ | bhītaṃ prapannaṃ paripāhi mṛtyoḥ śaraṇyamanyaṃ yadahaṃ na jāne ||38|| anvayaḥ yat anyaṃ śaraṇyaṃ ahaṃ na jāne(tasmāt) durvārasaṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ dodhūyamānaṃ mṛtyoḥbhītaṃ prapannaṃ(māṃ) paripāhi || 38|| bhāṣyam -- saṃsāra eva davāgniḥ sarvaśo vyāpya tāpahetutvāt vanānalaḥ , saḥ bhavadīyasadupadeśajanitajñānaṃ vinā na vārayituṃ śakya iti durvāraḥ| vārayituṃ svayamaśakya ityarthaḥ | dirvāraścāsau saṃsāradavāgniḥ tena taptaṃ dagdhaṃ , vanānalasya vātasahitatve bahuvyāpya tāpakatvaṃ prasiddham| tathā duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ duradṛṣṭāni pāpāni tānyeva vātāḥ pratikūlavāyavaḥ taiḥ dodhūyamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ kampyamānaṃ, anukūlaścedvātaḥ enamanyatra nayet , pratikūlastu vātaḥ, agnau pātayati agniṃ vā asmin | evaṃ davāgnitaptasya amṛtavarṣaṇe tāpamokṣo bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇa pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyeti viśeṣaṇaṃ dattam | tatra bahuvrīhimakṛtvā dṛṣṭyā karaṇena atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā sudhābhivarṣaṇena ityapi vaktuṃ śakyate | tena davāgnitaptaṃ māṃ mṛtyoḥ paripāhītyanvayaḥ | itthaṃ ca svakīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā māmuddhareti pūrvamanvayaḥ | tayā apikāruṇyasudhābhivarṣaṇena saṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ māṃ mṛtyḥ paripāhītyuttaratrānvayaḥ | mṛtyorbhītaṃ , prapannaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ, māṃ mṛtyoḥ paripāhītyubhayatrānvayaḥ | bhavadanugrahādātmajñāne sati mama śarīrotkramaṇarūpamaraṇaṃ na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | "natasya prāṇā utkrāmanti atraiva samavanīyante" iti śruteḥ | tathāca "dhṛvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca " ityuktatvāt maraṇābhāve janmābhāvasya siddhatvāt janmamaraṇapravāharūpasaṃsārāt mukto bhavāmi bhavadanugrahe iti bhāvaḥ |svasyānanyaśaraṇatvaṃ gurvābhimukhyāya prakaṭayati śaraṇyamanyaṃ yadahaṃ na jāne iti | bhavadanyaṃ madrakṣakaṃ yat yasmāt ahaṃ na jāne | ato'nanyaśaraṇo'yaṃ nodāsitavya iti bhāvaḥ | ||38|| ślokadvayena bhavādṛśāṃ asmāsu karuṇā nirvyājaivetyāha śāntā iti | śāntā mahānto nivasanti santo vasantavallokahitaṃ carantaḥ | tīrṇāssvayaṃ bhīmabhavārṇavaṃ janānahetunānyānapi tārayantaḥ ||39|| ayaṃ svabhāvassvata eva yatparaśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ mahātmanām | sudhāṃśureṣa svayamarkakarkaśaprabhābhitaptāmavati kṣitiṃ kila ||40|| anvayaḥ śāntāḥ mahāntaḥsantaḥ nivasanti vasantavat lokahitaṃ carantaḥ bhīmabhavārṇavaṃ svayaṃ tīrṇāḥ ahetunā anyān janān api tārayantaḥ|| 39|| ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ mahātmanām svata eva yat paraśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ (yathā) arkakarkaśaprabhābhitapta kṣitiṃ sudhāṃśureṣa svayaṃ avati kila|| 40|| bhāṣyam -- varṣāsu vṛṣṭibādhā , grīṣme tāpaḥ , śaradi prārambhe sukhaṃ , namāsadvaye kārtikāntimahāgasya yamadaṃṣṭrātvakīrtanāt , hemantaśiśirayośśaityaṃ, sugandhikusumākaraḥ vasantartuḥ kātsnryena lokasya sukhaṃ janayatīti vasantavadityuktaṃ tadā varṣatāpaśaityarogādīnāmabhāvāt | sa ṛtuḥ yathā sukhameva janayati tathā lokasya sukhameva tanvānāḥ śāntāḥ nirvikāramanaskāḥ ata eva mahāntaḥ, aparicchinnabrahmasākṣātkāravantaḥ, ata eva tādṛśasadbramābhedena santaḥ " brahmavit brahmaiva bhavatīti śruteḥ, svayaṃ bhīmaḥ bhayaṃkaraḥ yaḥ bhavārṇavaḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ taṃ tīrṇāḥ asaṃsāriṇa ityarthaḥ| svasya āptakāmatvena prayojanābhāvāt ahetunā hetuṃ vinā,anyānapi tārayantaḥ bhavāmbhodhimagnāniti bhāvaḥ| hetuṃ vinā kathaṃ teṣāṃ tattāraṇe nahi svabhāve kāraṇaṃ gaveṣaṇīyam | nahi śarkarāyāṃ mādhuryaṃ kiṃ nimittamiti praśno yujyate tatra tasya svābhāvikatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|paraśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ pareṣāṃ yaśśramaḥ duḥkhaṃ tasyāpanodaḥ nivāraṇaṃ tatra pravaṇaṃ bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ pravaṇabhāvaḥ pravaṇatā saktatā vaiyagryamityarthaḥ| iti yat ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ mahātmanāṃ svata eva | parapreraṇādikaṃ tatra nāpekṣyata ityarthaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntamāha sudhāṃśurityādinā | arkakarkaśaprabhābhitaptāṃ arkasya sūryasya yā karkaśā tīkṣṇā prabhā prakāśaḥ tayā abhitaḥ taptāṃ kṣitiṃ bhūmiṃ, sudhāṃśuḥ amṛtakiraṇaścandraḥ eṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ samīpavartī , svayaṃ parāpreritaḥ avati rakṣati, kileti prasiddhau ||40|| evaṃ vinītaveṣeṇa tadanusāriṇyā vācā tadabhivyaṃjitabhaktyāca ārtaḥ ananyaśaraṇo'yaṃ sarvathā rakṣaṇīya ityabhiprāyeṇa svābhimukhaṃ svātmānaṃ sānugrahānukampāmṛtavarṣikaṭākṣaiḥ pāvayantaṃ deśikottamaṃ svabandhamocakopadeśāya dhairyeṇa prārthayate | brahmānandetyādinā | brahmānandarasānubhūtikalitaiḥ pūtaiḥ suśītaiḥ sitaiḥ yuṣmadvākkalaśojjhitaiḥ śrutisukhaiḥ vākyāmṛtaiḥ secaya | saṃtaptaṃ bhavatāpadāvadahanajvālābhirenaṃ prabho dhanyāste bhavadīkṣaṇakṣaṇagateḥ pātrīkṛtāḥ svīkṛtāḥ ||41|| anvayaḥ he prabho brahmānandarasānubhūtikalitaiḥ pūtaiḥ suśītaiḥsitaiḥyuṣmad vāk kalaśa ujjhitaiḥ śrutisukhaiḥvākyāmṛtaiḥsecaya bhavatāpadāvadahanajvālābhiḥsaṃtaptaṃ enaṃ bhavadīkṣaṇakṣaṇagateḥpātrīkṛtāḥ svīkṛtāḥte dhanyāḥ|| 41|| bhāṣyam -- he prabho sarvaśakta, bhavadīkṣaṇakṣaṇagateḥ bhavatāṃ yadīkṣaṇaṃ dayārdrvilokanaṃ , tasya kṣaṇagateḥ kṣaṇaprāpteḥ, pātrīkṛtāḥ āspadībhūtāḥ, yadvā bhavatāṃ yadīkṣaṇaṃ nayanaṃ tasya kṣaṇagateḥ kṣaṇasaṃyogasya pātrīkṛtāḥ āśrayībhūtāḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ vā bhavannetrapātalakṣyā iti yāvat | ata eva svīkṛtāḥ ātmīyatvena kṛtāḥ ye puruṣāḥ te dhanyāḥ kṛtārthāḥ | tasmādahamapi bhavatkaṭākṣeṇa pātitatamāḥ pātitatamaśca dhanyo'smi | atikṣipraṃ sāṃsārikāgnitāpaṃ śiśamayiṣuḥ evaṃ prārthaye iti sūcayati | "śreyasi kena tṛpyate" iti nyāyena kaṭākṣapātraṃ māṃ svīkṛtaṃ bhavatāpadāvadahanajvālābhiḥ bhavasya tāpaḥ bhavatāpaḥ , saṃsāraśokaḥ sa eva dāvadahanaḥ vanāgni, tajjvālābhiḥ saṃtaptaṃ atyantadagdhaṃ, enaṃ parovartinaṃ , māṃ brahmānanda eva rasa iva āsvadyata iti rasaḥ, tadanubhūtikalitaiḥ tadanubhavamiśraiḥ , ata eva pūtaiḥ sakalakalmaṣahārakatvena pavitraiḥ "na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyata " iti smṛteḥ | tādṛśajñānavat vākyānāṃ sakala -- pāpāpahārakajñānopadeśa rūpatvena pūtatvam | suśītaiḥ āntarāṇāṃ ādhyātmikādhidaivikādhibhautika tāpānāṃ nāśakatvāt | sitaiḥ rajastamomārganivartanadvārā sattvamārgaikaprāpakatvena nirmalaiḥ | yuṣmadvākkalaśojjhitaiḥ yuṣmākaṃ vāk yuṣmadvāk , vāgindriyaṃ tatsthānaṃ mukhaṃ vā sa eva kalaśaḥ ghaṭaḥ tato nirgalanti vākyāmṛtānīti , tena ujjhitaiḥ visṛṣṭaiḥ, śrutisukhaiḥ karṇānandāyakaiḥ, vākyāmṛtaiḥ vākyānyevāmṛtāni tairityarthaḥ| secaya māṃ sicetyarthaḥ | svārthe ṇic | pūtatvaṃ suśītatvaṃ sitatvaṃ kalaśojjhitatvaṃ vākyeṣvamṛte cāviśiṣṭamiti vākyānyamṛtatvena rūpitāni | pūtatve hetuḥ brahmānandarasānubhūtikalitairiti, śrutisukhairiti śravaṇakāle'pi ānandakarairityanena tadarthamanusaṃdhāya yadyanubhava utpadyeta tādātvikaḥ ānandaḥ kimu vaktavya iti bhāvaḥ ||41|| pūrvaṃ bhītaṃ prapannaṃ ityatroktāṃ bhītiṃ spaṣṭayati sahasā svasminnanugrahasidhyartham | kathamityādinā | kathaṃ tareyaṃ bhavasindhumetaṃ kā vā gatirme katamostyupāyaḥ | jāne na kiṃcitkṛpayāva māṃ prabho saṃsāraduḥkhakṣatimātanuṣva ||42|| anvayaḥ etaṃ bhavasindhuṃ (ahaṃ)kathaṃ tareyaṃ ?me kā vā gatiḥ? katamaḥ asti upāyaḥ?(ahaṃ)kiñcit na jāne, kṛpayāḥ māṃ ava,he prabho saṃsāraduḥkhakṣatiṃ ātanuṣva|| 42|| bhāṣyam -- etaṃ bahuvidhadurvāraduḥkhajālajaṭilaṃ bhavasiṃdhuṃ kathaṃ tareyam | evameva yadi varteya me kāvā gatiḥ ? mayā kiṃ tāvatprāpyam ? sarvathā duḥkhameveti bhāvaḥ| ataḥ katamostyupāyaḥ etadbhavasindhutaraṇe kovopāyo'sti? ahaṃ tāvat kiṃcidapi na jāne | māmava evaṃ bhītaṃ paripāhi |avanaṃ spaṣṭam prārthayate saṃsāraduḥkhakṣatimātanuṣveti | sāṃsārikaśokaṃ samūlaghātaṃ jahītyarthaḥ ||42|| idānīṃ guroḥ kartavyamupadiśati, tathetyādinā, ślokadvayena | tathāvadantaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ svaṃ saṃsāradāvānalatāpataptam | nirīkṣya kāruṇyarasārdradṛṣṭyā dadyādabhītiṃ sahasā mahātmā ||43|| vidvānsa tasmā upasattimīyuṣe mumukṣave sādhu yathoktakāriṇe | praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya tattvopadeśaṃ kṛpayaiva kuryāt ||44|| anvayaḥ tathā vadantaṃ saṃsāradāvānalatāpataptam svaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ kāruṇyarasārdradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣya mahātmā(guruḥ)sahasā abhītiṃ dadyād || 43|| sa vidvān upasattiṃ īyuṣe mumukṣave sādhu yathoktakāriṇe tasmā praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya tattvopadeśaṃ kṛpayā kuryāt eva || 44|| bhāṣyam -- tathāvadantamityuktyā vāgvyāpāreṇa tadīyādhikārasya āntarasya samyajjñātuṃ śakyatvāt adhikāriṇaṃ jñātvaiva abhayadānopadeśādikaṃ gurubhiḥ kartavyamiti dyotitam | saṃsāradāvānalatāpataptaṃ, svaṃ svātmānaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ rakṣakatvena matvā prāptaṃ, kāruṇyarasārdradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣya, mahātmā akṣudrabuddhiḥ, guruḥ sahasā'bhītiṃ dadyādityanena bhītāḥ sahasā bhītyā mocanīyā iti vyañjitam | abhayadānena nivṛttabhītereva puruṣasya upadiṣṭārthagrahaṇādau sāmarthyaṃ sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | bhītasya bhayaṃ śaktena bahukālaṃ na sthāpanīyaṃ iti ca sahasetyuktam | bhītasyābhayadānaṃ prathamataḥ kartavyamityuktvā adhikārānusāreṇa upadeśaḥ anantarakālika iti bodhayati vidvānityādinā | sa vidvān brahmavittamo deśikaḥ , upasattimīyuṣe vidhivatsamīpaṃ gatāya mumukṣave mokṣaṃ kāmayamānāya, sādhuyathoktakāriṇe samyagvihitānuṣṭhātre | etena śiṣṭatvamuktam | "nāvirato duścaritāt nāśānto nāsamāhitaḥ | nāśāntamānaso vāpi prajñānenainamāpnuyāt " ityuktatvāt | śrotriyatvaṃ avṛjinatvaṃ mokṣakāmavyatiriktakāmaśūnyatvaṃ ca śiṣye avekṣaṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ| praśāntacittāya dehādibrahmaparyantabhogyavastuno virajya , svalakṣye niyatāvasthitamanaskāya, śamānvitāya nigṛhītabahirindriyāya, etena śamādiṣaṭkamuktam | adhikāriviśeṣaṇam | tasmai vairāgyādi guṇagaṇamaṇḍitāya, tattvopadeśaṃ kṛpayā tadīyaduḥkhaprahāṇecchayā āptakāmasya spṛhāntarābhāvāt kuryādevetyevakāro bhinnakramaḥ | adhikāriṇi labdhe nodāsitavyam , pātre dattā brahmavidyā lokānugrahārthaṃ pratiṣṭhitābhavatīti bhāvaḥ | itthaṃ ca sarvānarthahetubhūtāvidyānivartakabrahmavidyāpāraṃparyāvicchedaḥ svaśiṣyamocanaṃ ca upadeśasya phalam | tatra guruśiṣyasaṃvādarūpeṇa prakaraṇapraṇayanaṃ sulabhatayā tattvasya śrotṛbuddhyārohāya |ata eva kilākhyātyākhyāyikāṃ tatra tatra śrutirapi | tena gurulakṣaṇaṃ śiṣyalakṣaṇaṃ praṣṭavyādyaṃśāḥ sarve anāyāsena asmābhiḥ jñātuṃ śakyante iti ||44|| paramakāruṇiko guruḥ śiṣyeṇa "kathaṃ tareyaṃ bhavasindhumetaṃ " ityādinā darśitāṃ bhītiṃ jhaṭiti nināśayiṣurāha | mābhaiṣṭeti | mābhaiṣṭa vidvaṃstava nāstyapāyaḥ saṃsārasiṃdhostaraṇestyupāyaḥ | yenaiva yātā yatayosya pāraṃ tameva mārgaṃ tava nirdiśāmi||45|| anvayaḥ (he)vidvān mābhaiṣṭa tava apāyaḥnāsti saṃsārasindhoḥ taraṇe asti upāyaḥyatayaḥ asya pāraṃ yenaiva yātā tameva mārgaṃ tava nirdiśāmi|| 45|| bhāṣyam -- he vidvan bhavān mābhaiṣṭa , bhavato bhayaṃ mābhūditi sahasā abhītirdattā |vidvanniti sambodhayan vivekādikaṃ saṃpādya gurukaruṇāṃ vinā duḥkhataraṇaṃ na bhavatīti māṃ prāptastvaṃ jñātavyaṃ jānīṣa eva iti sūcayati , tādṛśasya tava sādhuyathoktakāriṇaḥ nāstyapāyaḥ "nahi kalyāṇakṛtkaścit durgatiṃtāta gacchati " iti smṛteḥ | ataḥ kathaṃ tareyam ,kāvā gatiriti maiva bhaiṣīrityarthaḥ | evaṃ mā bhaiṣṭa tava kalyāṇakartuḥ apāyo nāstīti tamāśvāsya katamo'styupāyaḥ ityasya uttaramāha saṃsārasiṃdhostaraṇe'styupāya iti | tatra samyagviśvāsotpatyarthaṃ tamupāyaṃ sapramāṇaṃ kathayati | yenaiva mārgeṇa asya saṃsārasindhoḥ pāraṃ antaṃ yatayaḥ prayatnaśīlāḥ saṃnyāsinaḥ , yātāḥ tameva mārgaṃ tava nirdiśāmi upadiśāmītyarthaḥ ||45|| tādṛśamārgaśuśrūṣāyāmautkaṭyasidhyarthaṃ punarapi sāmānyarūpeṇaiva upāyaṃ nirdiśati |astīti| astyupāyo mahānkaścit saṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ | tena tīrtvā bhavāmbhodhiṃ paramānandamāpsyasi ||46|| anvayaḥ saṃsārabhayanāśanaḥmahān kaścit asti upāyaḥ tena bhavāmbhodhiṃ tīrtvā paramānandaṃ āpsyasi || 46|| bhāṣyam -- saṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ mahān bahvāyāsasādhyasādhanasādhyaḥ kaścidupāyo'sti, tena vakṣyamāṇopāyena bhavāmbhodhiṃ dustaraṃ saṃsārasāgaraṃ tīrtvā tanmūlabhūtāṃ avidyāṃ bhaṃktvā paramānandaṃ niravadhikaṃ śāśvataṃ saṃtoṣaṃ, āpsyasi lapsyase ityarthaḥ | tena duḥkhanivṛttireva tvayā kāmyate mayopadekṣyamāṇopāyena tu duḥkhanivṛttireva tvayā kāmyate mayopadekṣyamāṇopāyena tu duḥkhamapyatyataṃ nivartate, nityaniratiśayānandāvirbhāvaśca tava bhavatīti śiṣyaḥ atyantamāpyāyita iti bhāvaḥ ||46|| tamupāyaṃ viśeṣato nirdiśati | vedānteti | vedāntārthavicāreṇa jāyate jñānamuttamam | tenātyantikasaṃsāraduḥkhanāśo bhavatyanu ||47|| anvayaḥ vedāntārthavicāreṇa uttamam jñānaṃ jāyate tena ātyantikasaṃsāraduḥkhanāśaḥanu bhavati || 47|| bhāṣyam -- vedānāmantāḥ vedāntāḥ upaniṣadaḥ tāsāṃ yo'rthaḥ tadvicāreṇa, upakramopasaṃhārādiṣaḍivadhatātparyaliṅgaiḥ pratipādyamānaḥ sajātīyasvagatabhedarahitaḥ nityaśuddhabuddhamuktasvabhāvaḥ paramātmā tasya vicāreṇa tannirṇayānukūlamānasavyāpāreṇa , uttamaṃ jñānaṃ saṃśayabhāvanādyaśabalitaṃ jñānaṃ nirṇayaḥ jāyate | tena nirṇayena ātyaṃtikasaṃsāraduḥkhanāśaḥ svasamānādhikaraṇaduḥkhaprāgabhāvāsamānakālikaḥ duḥkhanāśaḥ, anu tannirṇayānupadaṃ bhavati bhaviṣyatītyarthaḥ ||47|| idānīṃ tādṛśanirṇayāsādhāraṇahetūnāha | śraddhetyādinā | śraddhābhaktidhyānayogān mumukṣoḥ mukterhetūn vakti sākṣāt śrutergīḥ | yo vā eteṣveva tiṣṭhatyamuṣya mokṣo'vidyākalpitāddehabandhāt ||48|| anvayaḥ mumukṣoḥ mukteḥ hetūn śrutergīḥ śraddhābhaktidhyānayogān sākṣāt vakti eteṣveva tiṣṭhati amuṣya (tasya)avidyākalpitāt ddehabandhāt mokṣaḥ yo vā || 48|| bhāṣyam -- tatra śraddhāguruvedāntavākyaviśvāsaḥ śāstrasya guruvākyasyetyādinā lakṣitā |bhaktiḥ svasvarūpānusandhānaṃ nididhyāsanam | dhyānaṃ, "tatra pratyayaikatānatā dhyānaṃ " iti sūtritaṃ " samyagāsthāpanaṃ buddheḥ śuddheḥ brahmaṇi sarvadeti " lakṣitaṃ samādhānam | yogaḥ " yogāścittavṛttinirodhaḥ " iti sūtritaḥ | tatra śraddhā sarvatra hetuḥ | bhaktidhyānayogānāṃ madhye uttarottarasya pūrvapūrvahetutvam | cittavṛttinirodhe samādhānasya tasmin śrutācāryopadeśamanusvasvarūpānusandhānarūpanididhyāsanasya sambhavāt | yadvā dhyai cintāyāmiti dhātoḥ yuktibhiranucintanarūpaṃ mananaṃ nididhyāsanasākṣātkāraṇamucyate dhyānaśabdena, jñānapratibandhakasakaladuritanivartakaṃ saguṇadhyānaṃ vā |atrobhayatrāpi cittabāhyavṛttinirodharūpayogasya hetutvaṃ astyeva | yadvā yujyate sambadhyate ātmasākṣātkāreṇāneneti yogaḥ, bhaktiścāsau yogaḥ,dhyānaṃ ca tadyogaḥ iti bhaktiyogaḥ dhyānayogaḥ iti vā sambandhaḥ | mumukṣoḥ puruṣasya mukteḥ bandhanivṛtteḥ, hetūn śrutergīḥ " śraddhābhaktidhyānayogādavehi " iti kaivalyopaniṣat , sākṣādvakti pratyakṣaśrutirityarthaḥ |yadvā mukteḥ muktihetujñānasya sākṣāddhetūn sākṣātkāraṇānīti avehīti padaghaṭitā śrutiḥ vakti iti vā anvayaḥ| yo vai puruṣaḥ eteṣveva śraddhābhaktidhyānayogeṣu tiṣṭhati, śraddhāluḥ bhaktimān dhyātā yogī ca sadā bhavati, amuṣya adaśśabdaprayogeṇa tādṛśādhikāriṇaḥ durlabhatvaṃ sūcayati adasastu viprakṛṣṭamityukteḥ| tasya avidyākalpitāt ajñānamūlakāt dehabandhāt ahaṅkārādidehabandhāt ,mokṣaḥ nivṛttiḥ sidhyatyeveti śeṣaḥ| yovā ityatra vai ityavadhāraṇe, sa ante sambandhanīyaḥ | eteṣvevetyatra avadhāraṇaṃ uktasādhanānyaniṣṭhatvaṃ vārayati ||48|| idānīṃ guruḥ saṅgraheṇa śiṣyaṃ prati saṃsṛtihetuṃ tannidānaṃ tannivṛttyupāyaṃ ca sakāraṇamupadiśati | ajñānayogāditi | ajñānayogātparamātmanastava hyanātmabandhastata eva saṃsṛtiḥ | tayorvivekoditabodhavahniḥ ajñānakāryaṃ pradahetsamūlam ||49|| anvayaḥ paramātmanaḥ tava ajñānayogāt anātmabandhaḥ hi tata eva saṃsṛtiḥ tayoḥvivekoditabodhavahniḥ samūlam ajñānakāryaṃ pradahet ||49|| bhāṣyam -- paratmātmanastava ajñānayogāt anādyavidyāsambandhāt , anātmabandhaḥ anātmasu sthūlasūkṣmakāraṇaśarīreṣvātmatvabuddhiḥ | tata eva janmajarāmaraṇasukhaduḥkhajaḍatvādi dharmādhyāsarūpā saṃsṛtiḥ | tayoḥ ātmānātmanḥ vivokoditabodhavahniḥ vivekaḥ bhedajñānaṃ tena udito jātaḥ bodhavahniḥ sākṣātkārarūpāgniḥ samūlam ajñānarūpabījopetam ajñānakāryam ahaṃkārādidehāntabandhaṃ tatprayojyajanmajarāmaraṇādirūpasaṃsāraṃ ca pradahet prakarṣṇa bhasmīkuryādityarthaḥ | tathāca saṃsṛtikāraṇam anātmabandhaḥ , tatra kāraṇaṃ tavājñānayogaḥ , tannivṛttyupāyaḥ paramātmabodhaḥ tatra kāraṇam ātmānātmāvivekaḥ iti saṅgraheṇoktam | tena vedāntavicārajanyottamajñānasya saṃsāraduḥkhanāśakatvaviṣaye upapattiḥ pradarśitā ājñānikasya bandhasya jñānādeva nivṛttiḥ nānyata iti ||49|| itthaṃ gurumukhāravindanirgalitavāksudhāsyandānanditaḥ śiṣyaḥ tanmukhakalaśanirargalanirgaladvākyapīyūṣapārāvāre gāḍhaṃ mimaṅkṣuḥ svakīyasakalasandehabhañjanāya taṃ praṣṭuṃ vinayena prārthayate | śiṣya uvāca -- kṛpayā śrūyatāṃ svāmin praśno'yaṃ kriyate mayā | yaduttaramahaṃ śrutvā kṛtārthaḥ syāṃ bhavanmukhāt ||50|| anvayaḥ svāmin kṛpayā śrūyatāṃ ayaṃ praśnaḥ kriyate bhavanmukhāt yaduttaraṃ ahaṃ śrutvā mayā kṛtārthaḥ syāṃ ||50|| bhāṣyam -- etena gurusannidhāvanivedya praśno na kartavya iti śiṣyadharmo bodhitaḥ | yasya uttaraṃ yaduttaram | tatra praśno'yaṃ kriyate mayeti anuktvā, prathamaṃ kṛpayā śrūyatāmiti prārthanottaraṃ taduktyā guroḥ svasmin dayābhivṛddhaye mānasamārdavaṃ kṣiprajijñāsutvaṃ ca sūcitam | bhavanmukhāt śrutvetyanena svasya ananyaśaraṇatvaṃ gamitam ||50||
